script.text: Welcome to the family pet shop, Adam! Look at all the wonderful companion animals.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I see a playful dog wagging its tail and a sleepy cat in the sun, while a fluffy rabbit nibbles lettuce beside a tiny hamster!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Look in the heated enclosures: a swimming orange goldfish, a colorful talkative parrot, a slow green turtle, a gentle guinea pig, a singing yellow canary, and a curious little gerbil.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And look at the diverse canine breeds: a friendly golden retriever, a curly poodle, a sturdy bulldog, an alert german shepherd, and a loyal labrador!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Every animal deserves attentive care, affection, and responsible stewardship.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Notice the fascinating heritage breeds resting comfortably in their observation rooms.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Among the dog breeds, I recognize a hound beagle, a tiny chihuahua, a spotted dalmatian, a snowy arctic husky, and a wrinkly pug!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The cat salon is equally varied: a long-haired persian, a vocal siamese, a giant fluffy maine coon, a striped tabby, and an exotic spotted bengal.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: And right here: a placid ragdoll cat, a plush grey british shorthair, a hairless sphynx, an active abyssinian, and that adorable scottish fold with curled ears!

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Each breed has distinct traits and nutritional needs that owners must understand.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: A healthy pet requires balanced nutrition and reliable handling gear.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We stock premium dog food, organic cat food, floating fish food, fortified bird seed, sweet meadow hay, and crunchy reward treats.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For mealtime, I will set out a ceramic food bowl and a clean stainless steel water bowl, with a feeding bottle for orphaned puppies.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Before taking a dog outside, fit a comfortable collar, a braided leash, and an ergonomic chest harness.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: And remember indoor comfort: a rubber chew toy, a plush cushioned pet bed, and a safe, ventilated bird cage.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Proper hygiene and daily enrichment keep household pets vibrant and disease-free.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Look at the feline habitat aisle: a multi-level cat tree, a sisal scratching post, an enclosed litter box, and an insulated pet carrier with an engraved name tag!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Over by the aquatics, this glass aquarium filters crystal water, while the wellness shelf holds chewable pet vitamins, a minty dental chew, and topical flea treatment.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For thorough grooming, pick up mild oatmeal pet shampoo, a deshedding hair brush, an absorbent pet towel, and a safety nail clipper.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And for home cleanliness, don't forget puppy training pads and a sanitary pooper scooper for park walks!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The boutique section features delightful enclosures and adorable young animals.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Look at that lively little puppy chewing on a natural bone, and a purring kitten playing with a woolen bow!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A chirping green parakeet sings inside its ornate bird cage, while a golden hamster scurries across its tiered hamster cage.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: We feed nutritious fish flakes to tropical tetras and scatter wild birdseed in the aviary.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: And for winter walks: a warm knitted sweater, an embroidered bandana with a tiny tinkling bell, a waterproof raincoat, rubber paw booties, and a luxury orthopedic dog bed!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Our shop operates with licensed veterinary standards and transparent adoption ethics.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: In the front display window, a warm wooden rabbit hutch and a straw nesting box shelter rescued rabbits.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Inside, we have a temperature-controlled reptile terrarium, a decorative round fish bowl, and a quiet boarding kennel for traveling families.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: At our professional grooming station, wash coats with conditioning shampoo, fit an antiparasitic flea collar, and fill the trays with clumping cat litter.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Before finalizing at the cash register, Tariq checks the adoption board, scans the identification microchip, files the official vaccination card, and hands out a biodegradable poop bag roll!

lessons.name: The Pet Shop 7
lessons.titleEn: Daily Pet Care Actions & Store Layout

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Take a wire shopping basket, Adam. Look at every well-organized metal shelf and the informative educational poster.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Each glass aquarium tank and round ceramic bowl displays a clear price tag, right beside the spinning toy rack!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Owning a pet is a rewarding responsibility: you must feed wholesome food daily, walk your dog outside, groom tangled fur, and gently bathe messy coats.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: You should also train them with patience and positive reinforcement, play fun fetch games with a chew toy, and watch colourful fish swim peacefully.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Kindness toward all living creatures is the heart of true guardianship.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Bringing home a companion animal transforms a family with unconditional warmth and loyalty.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Rather than simply buying, choose to adopt an animal in need of a loving forever home.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: When you gently pet their soft ears and give them safe shelter, you gain a loyal friend for life.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Compassion and mercy in all our deeds.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A modern veterinary clinic provides specialized medical care for all types of animals.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Today we are examining a trembling dog, an anxious cat, a quiet rabbit, a tiny hamster, and a bright green parrot!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: And in the exotic suite: a shell-injured turtle, a squeaking guinea pig, a sluggish aquarium fish, a captive pet snake, and an agile ferret.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: First, record their body weight on the digital scale, check core temperature using a thermometer, and listen to heartbeat sounds through this stethoscope.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Then use the illuminated otoscope to inspect ear canals, and review the thoracic x-ray on the light screen!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Clinical diagnosis requires accurate laboratory tests before any invasive intervention.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: In the diagnostic lab, we analyze blood samples with a microscope and run a comprehensive blood test before performing an abdominal ultrasound.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The surgeon prepares a sterile syringe to administer an annual rabies vaccination or oral liquid medication.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In the operating theater, doctors perform ultrasonic dental cleaning, laparoscopic spay or neuter operations, and orthopedic fracture surgery.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: After closing the wound with delicate stitches and wrapping a clean white bandage, the patient rests in a fiberglass leg cast with a protective cone collar and an implanted microchip!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Follow me through the clinic layout, from public reception to specialized patient wards.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Pet owners check in at reception, resting in the quiet waiting room while keeping anxious dogs on a sturdy leather leash or cats inside an enclosed plastic carrier.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The patient is lifted onto the stainless steel exam table, while aggressive or frightened patients wear a soft safety muzzle.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Behind these doors lie the sterile operating room, the pathology lab, the prescription veterinary pharmacy, and the warm postoperative recovery room.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Down the hall, recoverees rest in a clean indoor kennel, exercise on the grassy outdoor run, visit the hygienic grooming area, and enjoy wholesome biscuits from a ceramic food bowl filled with rewards and treats!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: A successful hospital relies on seamless teamwork across every medical role.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: At the front desk, the polite receptionist greets each worried pet owner, checking the dog's collar, engraved ID tag, and refilling the waiting room water dish.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The head veterinarian collaborates with an orthopedic surgeon, a cardiology specialist, a learning intern, and an empathetic community volunteer.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Our skilled vet tech assists during blood draws, while the dedicated kennel attendant cleans kennels and monitors recovering patients.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Over in hygiene, the professional groomer uses safety nail clippers and a soft bristled grooming brush to keep coats tidy.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The warm aroma of morning baking fills the artisan bakery from before sunrise.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Look at the bread display: a long crusty baguette, a loaf of airy white bread, hearty whole wheat bread, and tangy sourdough alongside dark rye bread!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Over here we have Mediterranean specialties: pocket pita, herbed olive focaccia, porous ciabatta, rich golden brioche, and rustic flatbread.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: And on the breakfast tray: a buttery French croissant, a blueberry muffin, a glazed donut, a berry danish, and a warm cinnamon roll dripping with sugar icing.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Every culture around the world shares a deep heritage of baking grain.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The pastry chef's display case resembles an edible jewel gallery.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I see a chocolate glazed éclair, a cream tea scone, a warm spiced apple strudel, a pastel French macaron, and a cream-filled profiterole!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Look at the grand celebration showcase: a tiered wedding cake, a vibrant decorated birthday cake, a frosted vanilla cupcake, and a rich New York cheesecake.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Beside them stand a decadent dark chocolate cake, a spiced walnut carrot cake, and a fudgy chocolate brownie.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Don't overlook the fruit bakery: a double-crust apple pie, a tart cherry pie, and a zesty baked lemon tart.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Every exquisite baked creation begins with five fundamental baking ingredients.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: On the worktable, we measure fine milled flour, sweet granulated sugar, creamed butter, fresh farm eggs, and active dry yeast!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: From that base come delicious biscuits and cookies: a classic chocolate chip cookie, a delicate sugar cookie, spiced gingerbread, and buttery Scottish shortbread.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I also packed an oatmeal cookie, a crispy vanilla wafer, a golden morning biscuit, and a wholesome oat granola bar.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: And over on the snack counter: a salty twisted pretzel and a crisp whole-wheat cracker!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Step into the production kitchen to see the professional equipment and aromatic flavorings.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The pantry holds leavening baking powder, melted dark chocolate, pure vanilla extract, heavy whipping cream, rich cocoa powder, ground cinnamon, and raw golden honey!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Our baker uses a heavy planetary electric mixer and a smooth wooden rolling pin before preheating the stone deck oven.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Equip your workstation with a non-stick baking tray, a wire balloon whisk, a silicone bowl spatula, and a twelve-cup muffin tin.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And to decorate with precision, fill the conical piping bag with sweet royal icing!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Put on your clean canvas apron, Adam. The oven bell timer just rang!

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I will transfer the hot sourdough bread and a warm fruit pie straight onto the wire cooling rack.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Arrange the golden crusts inside the woven bread basket, and check on that glazed celebration cake.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Each batch takes patience: from a single cracked egg to a freshly baked cookie and a towering loaf.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A master craft that brings comfort and sustenance to the neighbourhood.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Welcome to the specialty coffee bar! The menu features handcrafted hot and cold beverages.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For classic coffee lovers, we pull a bold double espresso, pour a hot americano, steam a creamy flat white, and foam a velvety cappuccino or caramel macchiato.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I love milk drinks: a silky vanilla latte, a chocolatey mocha, a comforting mug of hot chocolate, or a spiced herbal chai!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: We also steep traditional organic tea leaves for those who prefer tea.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And for warm afternoons: a chilled glass of iced coffee, refreshing peach iced tea, a blended fruit smoothie, a frosty frappe, and sparkling mint lemonade!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Alongside barista espresso, our cold bar serves slow-steeped cold brew, fresh orange juice, fizzy fruit soda, crisp mineral water, and a thick vanilla milkshake.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Look at the pastry display case! A golden flaky croissant, a warm blueberry muffin, an English raisin scone, a chocolate chip cookie, and a moist cake slice!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For savory lunch options, choose a toasted sourdough sandwich, a cream cheese sesame bagel, or a slice of warm spinach quiche.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: And for an afternoon treat, pick between a ring glazed donut or a rich fudge walnut brownie.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The perfect pairing of nourishing food and hospitality.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Precision engineering is the secret behind consistent extraction.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The burr grinder doses fresh coffee grounds straight into the two-spout portafilter, compacted evenly with a flat steel tamper!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The barista locks it into the multi-boiler espresso machine, timing thirty seconds with a digital timer and measuring yield on an accurate scale.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: He steams microfoam milk with the stainless steel steam wand, checking heat with a milk thermometer, while a gooseneck kettle brews pour-overs and a high-speed blender crushes ice.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For takeaway, pour into a paper cup with a sip lid, an insulating cardboard sleeve, and a paper straw, or serve indoors in a ceramic mug!

lessons.name: The Coffee Shop 4
lessons.titleAr: أجواء المقهى ومحطة التحلية والمساحة المجتمعية

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: A neighbourhood coffee shop serves as an inviting community lounge.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: At the pickup counter, the friendly barista smiles beneath the glowing wooden menu board, beside a glass tip jar.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Head to the condiment station: grab an absorbent paper napkin, white sugar sachets, oat milk creamer, caramel syrup, and a wooden stirrer.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Choose your favorite seating: sink into a plush leather couch, or set up your laptop at a sturdy oak table.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: There is a wall electrical outlet for laptops, a clear wifi sign for internet, a curated community bookshelf, and a potted green fiddle-leaf plant.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Step up to the ice cream parlour counter, Adam! The chilled tubs display a rainbow of flavors.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For classic tastes, we have Madagascan vanilla, rich dark chocolate, sweet summer strawberry, and refreshing cool mint.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I want to try chewy chocolate chip cookie dough, salted golden caramel, tropical Alphonso mango, and crushed green pistachio!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: We also churn bold espresso coffee ice cream and vibrant pink bubblegum for the children.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Order a generous double scoop in a crunchy cone, assemble an extravagant hot fudge sundae, blend a thick milkshake, or enjoy dairy-free raspberry sorbet!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Beyond standard scoops, our parlour serves Italian gelato, tangy tart frozen yogurt, a fruity frozen popsicle, and an old-fashioned root beer float.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Look at the master banana split: three scoops nestled between banana halves, smothered in rainbow sprinkles and a mountain of whipped cream!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Drizzle warm dark hot fudge or buttery caramel sauce over the top, then garnish with roasted chopped nuts and a bright maraschino cherry.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: At the self-serve candy station, scatter crunchy Oreo cookie crumble, fruity chewy gummy bears, miniature marshmallow clouds, and dark chocolate chips!

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: An unforgettable dessert creation made with joy!

lessons.name: The Ice Cream Shop 3
lessons.titleAr: أقماع الآيس كريم وأدوات الخدمة والآلات

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A clean, efficient parlour requires specialized scooping and freezing equipment.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Will you have your scoop in a freshly pressed waffle cone, a crisp sugar cone, a paper cup, or a ceramic glass bowl?

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Take a colorful tasting spoon, an absorbent paper napkin, a carry-out tray, and an insulated take out box with a dome lid and a smoothie straw.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The deep batch freezer keeps tubs frozen behind the curved glass display case, where the server uses a heated mechanical scoop tool.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Over by the drinks station, the commercial milkshake blender spins at high speed beside the twin-lever soft serve machine!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: On warm summer afternoons, visitors love the cheerful atmosphere of the ice cream terrace.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Customers read the printed wall menu and the daily special on the rustic chalkboard, waiting patiently in line before reaching the ordering counter.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Behind the counter, the baker operates a hot waffle iron while guests explore the colorful topping bar and pay at the cash register.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Above the storefront, a striped canvas awning and a glowing neon light sign welcome families through the wide serving window.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Outside, people relax on a wooden bench beneath a shady parasol umbrella, enjoying comfortable outdoor seating beside a tidy trash can.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Welcome to Luigi's wood-fired pizzeria! The menu offers beloved Italian classics and hearty combinations.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The foundation is traditional margherita with creamy melted mozzarella, alongside spicy beef pepperoni, tropical hawaiian, and garden fresh veggie.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Meat fans order the meat lovers pie with seasoned Italian sausage, the smoky bbq chicken, or a rich four cheese blend!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For supreme loaded flavor, we add earthy sliced mushroom, black olive rings, crunchy green bell pepper, and sweet red onion.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: And don't forget the folded golden calzone, stuffed with ricotta and bubbling cheese!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Mastering pizza dough begins with following a traditional Neapolitan recipe.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Dust the wooden cutting board with white flour, roll the yeast dough with a wooden rolling pin, and ladle savory tomato sauce!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Garnish with fresh fragrant basil, sweet golden pineapple chunks, or salty Mediterranean anchovy fillets.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Using a long wooden pizza peel, slide the pizza directly onto the hot pizza stone inside the deck oven, setting the digital baking timer for seven minutes.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Once bubbling, cut every crispy slice and slide the hot pie into a cardboard delivery box!

lessons.name: The Pizza Shop 3
lessons.titleEn: The Kitchen Prep Station & Table Service

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The back of house operates with rapid precision around the central prep table.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Our walk-in refrigerator preserves chilled cheese blocks, shredded with a rotary grater, while the spiral mixer kneads sixty kilograms of flour.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The chef ladles sauce from a metal ladle, bakes in a roaring brick oven, and divides pies with a rolling wheel pizza cutter!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Out in the dining room, the laminated menu features warm toasted garlic bread, marinara dipping sauce, a crisp garden salad, and iced soda.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Serve the meal on a heated ceramic plate with a paper napkin, and pass the red pepper chili shaker!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The front counter manages dine-in guests alongside a steady stream of phone deliveries.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A cashier wearing a clean red apron takes orders by phone, printing a kitchen order ticket at the electronic cash register counter.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Finished pies stay piping hot on the stainless steel warming rack before couriers pack them into an insulated delivery bag mounted on a delivery bike.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Inside the restaurant, guests look through the arched glass window beneath the neon sign, choosing between an upholstered booth or a wooden table and chair.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Great food, fast service, and a welcoming dining atmosphere!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Welcome to the grand dining room! Every detail of the hospitality layout is meticulously arranged.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Guests can choose between a private cushioned booth, a tall leather bar stool by the counter, or an elegant round dining table and chair.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For families with young toddlers, the team provides a sturdy wooden high chair.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Notice the formal place setting: a white linen tablecloth, a floral table centerpiece, a scented wax candle, a folded cloth napkin, and a porcelain dinner plate.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And right beside the leather-bound menu sit a silver salt shaker and a matching pepper shaker.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Attentive table service requires refined etiquette and polished tableware.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A professional waiter carries a balanced serving tray, while our attentive waitress refills water glasses from a chilled glass pitcher.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For each course, place a soup spoon, a salad fork, a steak knife, a deep ceramic bowl, and a sparkling clear water glass.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For East Asian fusion dishes, we offer wooden chopsticks, while cold sodas come with a paper straw and stemware includes an elegant non-alcoholic wine glass.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: And to finish the meal, serve espresso in a porcelain cup and saucer, or herbal tea in a ceramic mug.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: A fine dining restaurant operates like a synchronized orchestra from front to back.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: At the foyer, the welcoming host and hostess greet arriving patrons, while the floor manager supervises service.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: In the kitchen, the executive chef directs each line cook, the diligent busser clears tables, and the industrial dishwasher sanitizes pans.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: At the drinks lounge, the mixology bartender, the beverage sommelier, and the specialty barista prepare refreshments.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Now review the four-course meal: a light savory appetizer, the chef's seasonal daily special, a hearty main course with a roasted vegetable side dish, and a decadent dessert!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Behind the dining partition, the hot kitchen line hums with intense culinary energy.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The saute cook stirs soup in a stock pot with a ladle, flips patties on the gas stove using a silicone spatula, and fries potatoes in the deep fryer!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Over the open char grill and convection oven, a cast iron pan sizzles, while the prep cook dices herbs on a poly cutting board.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The server jots orders on a leather order pad, verifying each evening table reservation.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: At the end of the evening, the waiter presents the dinner bill and itemized check; the satisfied diner leaves a generous gratuity tip and takes the printed payment receipt.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The restaurant menu celebrates culinary diversity across global cuisines.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Our walk-in refrigerator and deep freezer preserve fresh ingredients, washed in the stainless steel prep sink before the chef whips cream with a whisk or runs the planetary mixer.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Look at the dishes passing through the kitchen window: steaming lentil soup, a garden green salad, and warm oven baked bread with fluffy steamed jasmine rice!

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Guests are enjoying seared beef steak, creamy Italian pasta, stone-baked pizza, a clubhouse sandwich, a flame-broiled burger, and fresh Japanese sushi rolls!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Flavors from every continent united by culinary craftsmanship.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The true mark of a master chef lies in the final finishing touches before plating.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Balance every nuance of flavor with aromatic herbal seasoning and a velvety pan sauce reduction.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Toss the greens with an emulsified vinaigrette dressing, and crown the entree with an edible flower garnish!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: A feast that delights both the eye and the palate.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Welcome to the central supermarket! Let's begin our shopping in the produce department.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Look at the colorful fruit display: a crisp green apple, a ripe yellow banana, a sweet citrus orange, and a bunch of purple grapes!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Pick up a carton of red strawberry punnets, a juicy tropical mango, a fragrant velvety peach, and a firm Bartlett pear.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Over by the melons, this heavy striped watermelon and spiky golden pineapple look delicious!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Now select our cooking vegetables: a plump vine tomato, crisp green lettuce, a crunchy orange carrot, an earthy potato, and a pungent cooking onion.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The exotic fruit counter features seasonal stone fruits and berries.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I see a deep purple plum, sweet dark cherry boxes, fresh blueberry punnets, and delicate red raspberry packs!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Grab a sour yellow lemon, a zesty green lime, a creamy salad avocado, a fuzzy brown kiwi, and a tropical hard-shelled coconut.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Over here: a ruby seed pomegranate, a tart pink grapefruit, a ripe sweet cantaloupe, and a honeyed fresh fig.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And in the chilled misting section, load up fresh florets of green broccoli and white cauliflower!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: These vegetable bins are stocked with crisp greens and root crops.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Let's grab a cool English cucumber, a crunchy bell pepper, yellow sweet corn on the cob, and a bag of baby leaf spinach.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Add an earthy button mushroom, a stalk of crunchy celery, a dark green zucchini, and a glossy purple eggplant.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: We also need sweet tender garden peas, crisp snapping green beans, and a dense head of green cabbage.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: To finish our dinner soup, weigh a nutritious sweet potato, a decorative orange pumpkin, tender spears of green asparagus, and a peppery red radish!

lessons.name: The Supermarket 4
lessons.titleAr: جذور الخريف والخضار الورقية والفلفل الحار

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Notice these seasonal autumn varieties and specialty cooking produce.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I found sweet orange apricot halves, smooth skinned nectarine crates, wild blackberry packs, and tart red cranberry bags!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Pick a fragrant peeled tangerine, a golden tropical papaya, curly dark green kale, and a long white leek.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Carefully inspect these miniature brussels sprouts, a bunch of slender green onion, a purple top turnip, and a spiky globe artichoke.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And for spicy cooking, take one spicy green jalapeño, a rich purple beet, and a yellow summer squash!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The aromatic herb section offers fresh cuttings for fragrant marinades.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We have sweet fragrant basil, woodsy thyme, needle-like rosemary, fresh curly parsley, and cooling green mint.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Add fresh cilantro for salsa, feathery pickle dill, finely chopped chives, velvety sage leaves, a dried bay leaf, licorice tarragon, and citrusy lemongrass stalks.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Now turn toward dairy aisle one: pick a fresh gallon of whole milk, a block of artisan cheese, and creamy probiotic yogurt.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A balanced cart filled with green freshness and nutritious dairy!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Check the dairy wall for cooking fats and sandwich fillings.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We need salted baking butter, a carton of fresh farm eggs, heavy whipping cream, and chilled breakfast juice.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In the freezer cabinets: a tub of vanilla ice cream, an emergency frozen pizza, and bags of mixed frozen vegetables.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Back in dairy, pick up tangy sour cream, an aerosol can of whipped cream, curded cottage cheese, and plant-based protein tofu.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And for sandwiches: smooth bagel cream cheese, plant margarine, shredded melting mozzarella, and sharp yellow cheddar block!

lessons.name: The Supermarket 7
lessons.titleEn: Cheeses, Plant Milks & The Bread Aisle

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Here we find Mediterranean cheeses and plant-based milk alternatives.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Let's take a wedge of aged Italian parmesan, crumbly Greek feta, unsweetened almond milk, and creamy barista oat milk!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Next, browse the bakery shelves: a fresh sliced loaf of white bread, a chewy breakfast bagel, a flaky buttery croissant, and a blueberry muffin.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For family celebrations, there is a frosted sponge cake, alongside pantry staples: long grain basmati rice, durum wheat pasta, morning breakfast cereal, and unbleached flour.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Don't forget soft taco tortilla wraps and a glazed ring donut for our snack!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Aisle four houses wholesome whole grains and artisanal bread varieties.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Look at the baked goods: a golden apple pie, flaky southern biscuit dough, boxed pancake mix, morning oatmeal, and skillet cornbread.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: From the specialty baker: a crusty French baguette, pocket pita bread, warm garlic naan, a soft dinner roll, a toasted breakfast waffle, and rustic sliced sourdough.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: And on the dry shelves, grab Asian stir-fry noodles, North African steamed couscous, high-protein Peruvian quinoa, and a loaf of sliced whole wheat bread.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Such a diverse spectrum of healthy complex carbohydrates!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Our butcher and fishmonger counters provide fresh proteins for every culinary preference.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We have whole roasting chicken, tender cuts of lean beef, smoked pork, fresh white fish fillets, and wild caught pink shrimp.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In the prepared section: breakfast sausage links, crispy cured bacon, sliced roasted deli turkey, and sweet baked ham.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: On crushed ice: Atlantic pink salmon steaks, fresh sashimi-grade tuna, tender grass-fed lamb chops, and roasted duck breasts.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And in the live saltwater tank: a live Maine lobster and a giant red king crab!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Push our steel shopping cart smoothly, Adam, while I carry this plastic hand basket.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Look at the butcher cuts on that refrigerated shelf: lean ground beef, marbled ribeye steak, barbecue beef ribs, a poultry drumstick, and a crispy chicken wing!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The seafood display holds fresh steamer clam shells, briny raw oyster halves, tender calamari squid, and flaky white cod fillets.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: We are currently in aisle six; once we finish, we will proceed to the front checkout counter.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Every product package has a scannable digital barcode printed on the label!

lessons.name: The Supermarket 11
lessons.titleAr: قسم الأغذية الجاهزة والموازين ونقاط الدفع

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Before we reach the registers, stop at the deli counter for freshly sliced cheeses and a bar of olive oil soap.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Check every shelf price tag and bright yellow sale sign, always confirming the printed expiration date on each package!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: At the front, customers can choose an express lane with a human cashier, or use a computerized self checkout kiosk.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Unload items onto the motorized conveyor belt, weigh loose apples on the digital scale, and watch the optical laser scanner beep!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Scan your digital loyalty card, apply this discount paper coupon, pay at the cash register, and pocket your printed paper receipt.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Aisle eight stocks essential home maintenance and kitchen paper supplies.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We need laundry washing detergent, a heavy-duty scrubbing sponge, a perforated roll of paper towel, and a box of drawstring trash bag liners.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Pick up sanitizing liquid bleach, a wet floor mop, and a stiff bristle sweeping broom for the garage.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Over in hardware: a warm LED light bulb, a pack of alkaline battery cells, citrus degreasing dish soap, and a multi-pack of soft toilet paper.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For food packing: paper dinner napkin packs, heavy-duty aluminum foil, clingy clear plastic wrap, and yellow protective rubber gloves!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Complete our cleaning supplies with a matching dustpan, an aerosol floral air freshener, surface disinfectant spray, and a sturdy plastic mop bucket.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Now let's turn into the beverage aisle: pick up a gallon of purified drinking water, fizzy fruit soda, whole roasted bean coffee, and aromatic herbal tea!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For warm afternoons, grab chilled cloudy lemonade, an electrolyte energy drink, non-alcoholic root beer, non-alcoholic grape wine, and effervescent sparkling water.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And for cold evenings: a tin of rich Swiss hot chocolate powder, and a fresh cold milk carton!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Every beverage you need to stay hydrated and energized throughout the week.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The cold beverage fridge holds refreshing 100% pure juices.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I see pulp-free orange juice, bottled peach iced tea, hydrating raw coconut water, a bottled strawberry smoothie, and clear pressed apple juice!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Beside them stand a bottled creamy milkshake, fizzy dry ginger ale, natural European mineral water, and non-alcoholic sparkling grape champagne.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Now look down the party snack aisle: crunchy salted potato chips, baked chocolate chip cookies, rich milk chocolate bars, and chewy gummy candy!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Grab a box of crisp water crackers and a bag of buttery movie popcorn for our weekend study session.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Let's select nutritious on-the-go snacks before checking the canned pantry.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We have roasted mixed nuts, sugar-free chewing gum, a crunchy oat granola bar, salted knot pretzels, and a chocolate fudge brownie.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In the refrigerated dessert tubs: smooth vanilla pudding, wholesome hiking trail mix with sun-dried dried fruit, miniature marshmallow bags, and a swirl fruit lollipop.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: In the freezer, grab a frozen fruit ice pop, and from the pantry shelves, sweet strawberry jelly and a can of chicken canned soup!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: And don't forget the classic pairing: creamy roasted peanut butter and artisan berry jam.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Aisle eleven features pantry essentials, cooking oils, and savory condiments.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We need a squeeze bottle of tomato ketchup, tangy yellow mustard, smooth egg mayonnaise, and protein-rich canned beans.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Pick up spicy tomato salsa, a jar of dill pickles, extra virgin cold-pressed olive oil, rich marinara tomato sauce, and canned unsweetened coconut milk.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In the canned fish section: a solid white albacore tuna can and olive oil packed sardines.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: To finish our sauces, take golden clover honey, pure Canadian maple syrup, concentrated tomato paste, and savory vegetable broth!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A well-stocked kitchen requires foundational cooking oils and table seasonings.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Grab a bottle of neutral vegetable oil, smoky hickory bbq sauce, creamy almond butter, chocolate hazelnut nutella, and sweet pickle relish.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For breakfast toast: citrus orange marmalade, alongside table basics: iodized fine salt, cracked black pepper, white granulated sugar, and distilled white vinegar.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Add savory dark soy sauce, fiery aged cayenne hot sauce, fragrant ground cinnamon, fresh purple garlic bulbs, and dried Mediterranean oregano!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A complete spectrum of world culinary flavors.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The spice racks showcase ground botanicals that define international cooking traditions.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I see earthy ground cumin, smoky sweet paprika, vibrant golden turmeric, grated nutmeg, pungent ginger powder, and spicy red chili flakes!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For baking, choose pure vanilla extract, leavening baking soda, double-acting baking powder, and moist molasses brown sugar.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: And for aromatic curries: Madras curry powder, fiery ground cayenne, whole aromatic cloves, and green cardamom pods.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Now cross into aisle fourteen to pick up a bottle of conditioning hair shampoo!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Maintaining personal hygiene and wellness is part of our everyday routine.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: In dental care, we need fluoride mint toothpaste, a soft-bristle toothbrush, antiseptic mouthwash, and waxed dental floss.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For grooming: long-lasting deodorant, a safety blade razor, an unbleached pocket tissue pack, moisturizing hand lotion, and SPF fifty sunscreen.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Grab a box of adhesive band-aid strips, baby diapers for family, nourishing hair conditioner, and hydrating shower body wash.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And in facial care: sterile soft cotton balls and an anti-static styling comb!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: At the supermarket pharmacy counter, we can pick up wellness essentials.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Take soothing beeswax lip balm, an alcohol hand sanitizer gel, daily multivitamin vitamins, and prescribed cough medicine.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Observe how products are packaged across the store: a steel can of peaches, a glass bottle of oil, a cardboard cereal box, and a glass jam jar.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: We also have a plastic bread bag, a paper egg carton, an aluminum toothpaste tube, a foil snack wrapper, and a sealed plastic package.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Heavy goods arrive in an airtight plastic container, delivered in a sturdy wooden fruit crate!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Notice how experienced shoppers shop methodically through the aisles.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I grab a plastic meat tray, a fresh bunch of bananas, a crusty loaf of bread, a carton containing a dozen eggs, and a refill soap pouch.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Let's push the cart down the aisle, pull items forward, and weigh our loose apples on the hanging scale.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We compare ingredient labels, choose the best value, and reach up to the top shelf to pick items as clerks stock the shelves.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: At the register, we unload our groceries, watch the cashier scan barcodes, and pay securely by card!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Every department functions smoothly thanks to dedicated supermarket personnel.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Every polite customer and busy shopper will browse the aisles, wait in line patiently, and check out at the register.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The skilled butcher cuts a pound of ground beef, the baker bakes fresh rolls, and the stock clerk replenishes cereal boxes.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The friendly bagger helps load grocery bags, while the store manager oversees customer service and the security guard keeps the entrance safe.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Outside, we carry reusable bags to the car, while an express delivery driver departs with online grocery orders!

lessons.name: The Supermarket 23
lessons.titleAr: أدوات التجزئة ووحدات القياس والعلامات الغذائية

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Precise quantifiers and dietary certifications help shoppers select the right food.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Our grocery list includes a gallon of milk, a bunch of grapes, a head of lettuce, a loaf of bread, and a dozen eggs!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: We also ordered a slice of cheese, a piece of dark chocolate, a pack of napkins, a handful of walnuts, a pint of blueberries, and a stick of butter.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Be sure to verify health labels: certified organic produce, certified gluten-free crackers, diabetic sugar-free jam, and heart-healthy low-fat yogurt.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Clear labeling empowers healthy choices for every family.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Navigating a supermarket involves common conversational phrases.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Excuse me, where can I find olive oil? Do you have gluten-free pasta, and how much is this melon?

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Check the shelf tag: it is fresh, non-gmo, certified vegan, and currently on sale with a buy 1 get 1 free promotion!

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Read the nutrition facts panel and check the best before date before choosing between fresh or frozen berries.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: At the checkout register, the clerk asks: paper or plastic? Is this on sale? Cash or card? And I respond: can I get a bag, please?

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Excuse me, where is aisle three? Can I taste this sliced deli salami before purchasing?

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Certainly! And ask the deli clerk: is this fresh hummus made today? Also, I have a coupon for this root ginger.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Over at the customer service desk, a shopper inquires: I need a refund for this duplicate charge, please.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: With all our errands complete, let's return our wheeled cart to the front bay.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A successful and pleasant shopping trip from start to finish!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Welcome to the butcher hall, where fresh poultry and prime cuts are organized by culinary department.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: On the poultry counter, we have whole roast chicken, seasonal turkey, rich game duck, roasted goose, and tiny delicate quail.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Look closer at the chicken portions: skinless chicken breast fillets, a crispy drumstick, a glazed barbecue wing, and a succulent chicken thigh.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Beside them lies lean ground turkey, while the red meat displays showcase grass-fed beef, tender spring lamb, delicate veal, and labeled cuts of pork.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And right here in the glass case is a beautifully marbled beef steak ready for the grill!

lessons.name: Meat & Seafood 2
lessons.titleAr: لحوم الشواء البطيء وأصناف المأكولات البحرية الطازجة

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Now observe the slow-cooking roasts and the fresh seafood on crushed ice.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For weekend braising, we could select a holiday roast, a package of ground beef for pasta, barbecued ribs, prime beef tenderloin, or slow-smoked brisket.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: And the fishmonger offers wild Atlantic salmon, thick red tuna steaks, and flaky white Atlantic cod.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Look at the shellfish selection: jumbo pink shrimp, live Maine lobster, Dungeness crab, and freshly harvested oyster shells.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Let's also take a black mussel pot, a dozen sweet sea clam shells, and a delicate seared sea scallop.

lessons.name: Meat & Seafood 3
lessons.titleAr: اللحوم المقددة والمقطوعات الخاصة لدى الجزار

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: This refrigerated counter features specialty cured meats and artisan butcher cuts.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For savory breakfast and snacks, they sell crispy bacon strips, spiced breakfast sausage, cured deli ham, aged Italian salami, and thin prosciutto.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Further along are spicy pepperoni slices, a grilled beef hot dog, chewy seasoned jerky, Spanish smoky chorizo, and peppered beef pastrami.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For butchered cuts, examine this trimmed fish fillet, a thick bone-in pork chop, and a breaded veal cutlet.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And for dinner stewing, Chef Omar recommends a tender beef medallion and a slow-braised lamb shank!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Let us review butchery terminology and culinary meat preparation styles.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A butcher trims a boneless tender loin, then French-trims an impressive rosemary lamb rack.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For cooking versatility, meat can be ground for burgers, diced into cubes for kebabs, or thinly sliced for deli sandwiches.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Understanding loin cuts, a roasted rack, ground mince, diced stew meat, and sliced roast helps us order with absolute precision!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: This aisle displays wholesome cereal grains and freshly baked artisanal loaves.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For grain bowls, we have fluffy white rice, golden wheat berries, rolled morning oats, pearled barley, and protein-packed Andean quinoa.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Beside them are sweet yellow corn, ancient millet seeds, earthy buckwheat groats, dark rye grain, and cracked bulgur wheat.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Over at the bakery case, pick up warm sliced bread, crispy morning toast, a chewy sesame bagel, a buttery French croissant, and a crusty French baguette.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A magnificent array of ancient grains and golden bakery staples!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Now let's explore flatbreads, rolls, and pasta shapes from around the world.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We have pocket pita bread, a soft corn tortilla, a blueberry muffin, a soft dinner roll, and an artisan tangy sourdough loaf.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In the Italian pasta section: long durum spaghetti, diagonal tubular penne, ribbon fettuccine, curved elbow macaroni, and flat linguine noodles.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We can also pick stuffed cheese ravioli, wide layered sheets for lasagna, Japanese curly ramen, thick wheat udon, and delicate Asian rice noodle boxes.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Every type of noodle and flatbread we need for international cooking!

lessons.name: Grains & Dairy 3
lessons.titleEn: Fresh Dairy, Farm Eggs & Plant Proteins
lessons.titleAr: الألبان الطازجة وبيض المزرعة والبروتينات النباتية

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The refrigerated dairy and protein case stores cold-chain breakfast essentials.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We'll fetch pasteurized milk, sharp cheddar cheese, thick Greek yogurt, golden unsalted butter, and rich heavy cooking cream.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Don't forget tangy sour cream for baked potatoes, high-protein cottage cheese, spreadable cream cheese, and sweet dessert whipped cream.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Grab a pint of vanilla ice cream, a farm-fresh egg, separated egg white for meringue, and rich egg yolk for custard.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And for plant-based protein options, let's select a block of firm soybean tofu and fermented nutty tempeh!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Let us review modern plant-based protein options and dairy alternatives.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Chefs use high-protein wheat seitan for hearty plant roasts, while customers choose fortified plant milk for their morning cereals.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The dairy-free refrigerator features nutty unsweetened almond milk, creamy barista oat milk, and rich calcium-fortified soy milk.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Knowing wheat seitan and various types of plant milk ensures every customer finds their favorite breakfast match!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Welcome to the beverage counter, offering hot comforting brews and chilled summer refreshments.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For hot morning drinks, we can order freshly roasted coffee, aromatic black tea, rich hot chocolate, a concentrated shot of espresso, and a foamy cappuccino.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Or try a steamed milky latte, a chocolate mocha, soothing herbal tea, antioxidant green tea, or spiced Indian chai.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: And when you need cold drinks, choose pure filtered water, chilled sweetened iced tea, tangy lemon lemonade, a tall iced coffee, or a creamy blended milkshake.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Every temperature and flavor profile for morning and afternoon refreshment!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The fresh juice bar and chilled cooler offer fruity, sparkling, and blended thirst-quenchers.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I love a blended fruit smoothie, an icy strawberry slushie, effervescent sparkling water, bitter botanical tonic water, and smooth nitrogen-infused cold brew.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In the fruit juice refrigerators: freshly pressed orange juice, crisp golden apple juice, sweet concord grape juice, and tart red cranberry juice.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We can also sample savory red tomato juice, vitamin-rich carrot juice, tropical pineapple juice, exotic mango juice, and antioxidant pomegranate juice.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And the barista makes a wonderful citrus fresh squeeze right before your eyes!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The beverage department separates sparkling sodas, athletic drinks, fermented teas, and specialty hospitality beverages.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Here are fizzy soda cans, dark cola, spicy ginger ale, sweet root beer, vanilla cream soda, and bubbly lemon-lime soda.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For athletic hydration, they stock a caffeinated energy drink, an electrolyte sports drink, probiotic kombucha, and hydrating coconut water.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: On the hospitality shelves, international displays include malt beer, vintage wine, sparkling celebration champagne, and classic distilled spirits like oak-aged whiskey and grain vodka.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A complete spectrum of everyday hydration and international beverage culture!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Hospitality bar menus and gourmet sauce reductions frequently utilize classic aromatic base flavor profiles.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: In gourmet kitchens, pastry chefs use botanical gin herbs, sugarcane rum glaze, agave tequila reductions, and fruit brandy sauces.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: A professional bartender balances these distinct aromatic elements into an exquisite signature cocktail.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Mastering gin, rum, tequila, brandy, and craft cocktail terminology gives learners complete restaurant fluency!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: A culinary kitchen relies on high-quality cutlery, prep tools, and essential cookware.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: On the magnetic knife rack: a balanced chef's knife for chopping, a small paring knife for peeling, a serrated bread knife, and a heavy meat cleaver.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Beside the wooden cutting board and whetstone knife sharpener, keep kitchen scissors, a vegetable peeler, a four-sided box grater, and an adjustable mandoline slicer.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For stovetop cookery, choose a nonstick frying pan, a simmering saucepan, a large soup stock pot, a round carbon-steel wok, and a heavy cast-iron Dutch oven.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Equipped with these foundational blades and cookware, our culinary preparation is effortless!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Now let's examine baking vessels, pans, and everyday manual stirring utensils.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For oven and stovetop cooking: a cast-iron skillet, a flat baking sheet for cookies, a ceramic casserole dish, a turkey roasting pan, and a flat pancake griddle.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: To handle food safely: a silicone flipping spatula, a deep soup ladle, metal locking tongs, and a balloon wire whisk.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We also use a classic wooden spoon, a perforated slotted spoon for boiling vegetables, a marble pastry rolling pin, a pasta colander, a fine mesh strainer, and a narrow pouring funnel.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Every tool has a specific ergonomic purpose in the kitchen brigade!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Precision measurement and benchtop small appliances ensure flawless culinary execution.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For precise baking ratios: a clear measuring cup, a nested measuring spoon set, an accurate digital kitchen scale, a probe meat thermometer, and a loud digital countdown timer.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Use a spouted liquid measure for broth, a level dry measure cup for flour, a small teaspoon of vanilla, a level tablespoon of honey, and a marked ounce glass.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Along the appliance counter: a high-speed smoothie blender, a multi-blade food processor, a stand mixer for dough, a bread toaster, and an electric tea kettle.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Accurate measurements and reliable countertop appliances make every recipe reproducible!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Let us inspect specialized electric kitchen appliances for breakfast and daily meal prep.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: On the prep counter: an automated fuzzy-logic rice cooker, a ceramic slow cooker for tender stews, and a double belgian waffle iron.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Beside them stand a cold-press masticating juicer for fresh morning citrus and a programmable drip coffee maker.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Mastering these smart culinary appliances streamlines cooking from morning breakfast to evening dinner!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Culinary arts begin with mastering moist-heat and dry-heat thermal cooking methods.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For moist heat: rapidly boil pasta, gently simmer broth, steam fresh dumplings, quickly blanch crisp greens in ice water, and poach delicate eggs.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For tenderizing tough cuts: slowly stew hearty vegetables, braise beef shanks, pressure-cook legumes quickly, double-boil chocolate, and parboil potatoes.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For dry heat and oven cookery: bake artisan sourdough, roast a seasoned chicken, grill kebabs over charcoal, broil cheese until bubbly, and toast crusty bread slices.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Every temperature control method unlocks unique flavors and textures!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Now let's examine high-heat searing, artisanal frying styles, and barbecue techniques.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We char sweet peppers over open flames, smoke brisket with hickory wood, dehydrate fruit slices, barbecue ribs, and roast chicken on a rotating rotisserie.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In oil cookery: fry eggs sunny side up, deep-fry golden chips, sauté aromatic garlic, and stir-fry colorful vegetables in a searing hot wok.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: You can also pan-fry fish fillets, shallow-fry breaded cutlets, sear a steak crust, dramatically flambé with dessert sauces, fry crispy Japanese tempura, and flash-fry calamari.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: High-heat cooking creates unmatched aroma and crispy texture!

lessons.name: Cooking Methods 3
lessons.titleEn: Knife Cuts, Food Prep & Dough Mixing
lessons.titleAr: تقطيع السكين وتجهيز الطعام وخلط العجين

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Mastering knife cuts and manual mixing techniques is essential for kitchen efficiency.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We roughly chop fresh herbs, dice crisp onions into small cubes, mince garlic cloves finely, slice ripe tomatoes, and julienne carrots into matchsticks.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Then grate parmesan cheese, peel russet potatoes, zest lemon peel for aroma, crush whole black peppercorns, and blend a smooth soup.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For baking prep: mix dry seasonings, stir a warm sauce constantly, whisk egg whites to peaks, gently fold in berries, and knead elastic yeast dough.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Flawless knife discipline and stirring technique make all the difference in gourmet cooking!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Let us conclude with foundational finishing actions and culinary flavor infusions.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Bakers beat whole eggs vigorously and cream butter with sugar until light and fluffy.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Chefs toss crisp salad greens with vinaigrette, marinate steaks in herb oil, and glaze pastries with shiny apricot syrup.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: These five finishing techniques transform simple ingredients into polished gourmet presentations!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Spices and dried herbs create the aromatic foundation of international cuisine.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For essential seasoning, we use sea salt and cracked black pepper, then add smoky Spanish paprika, warm sweet cinnamon, and earthy ground cumin.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Add vibrant golden turmeric, fiery red chili powder, grated nutty nutmeg, aromatic whole clove, and fragrant crushed cardamom pods.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For Mediterranean seasoning: sweet dried basil, pungent oregano, savory woodsy thyme, needle-like rosemary, and bright parsley flakes.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: With these fifteen spices and herbs, any broth or marinade bursts with flavor!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Now let's examine fresh garnishing herbs and popular bottled table condiments.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For fresh herbs: zesty chopped cilantro, feathery pickle dill, cooling fresh mint, a dried bay leaf for stews, and velvety garden sage.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: On the condiment shelf: sweet tomato ketchup, sharp yellow mustard, creamy mayonnaise, savory umami soy sauce, and spicy vinegar hot sauce.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We also have savory Worcestershire sauce, smoky sweet barbecue sauce, Japanese glazed teriyaki, Italian basil pesto, and fresh chunky Mexican salsa.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A diverse pantry of sauces and dressings from around the globe!

lessons.name: Seasonings & Condiments 3
lessons.titleEn: Culinary Oils, Aged Vinegars & Natural Sweeteners
lessons.titleAr: زيوت الطهي والخل المعتق والمحليات الطبيعية

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Oils, vinegars, and natural sweeteners provide balance in dressings, marinades, and baked goods.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For cooking oils: extra virgin olive oil, neutral vegetable oil, tropical coconut oil, toasted Asian sesame oil, and gourmet black truffle oil.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For balancing acidity: aged Italian balsamic vinegar, red wine vinegar, tangy apple cider vinegar, mild Asian rice vinegar, and distilled white vinegar.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For sweetening: pure granulated sugar, golden wildflower honey, rich amber maple syrup, chunky fruit jam, and clear grape jelly.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Balancing healthy oils, acidic vinegars, and gentle sweetness creates culinary harmony!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Let us inspect rich specialty spreads, molasses syrups, and natural nectar glazes.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For breakfast toast: creamy roasted peanut butter, sweet chocolate hazelnut Nutella, and bitter Seville orange marmalade.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For deep baking flavor: dark unrefined cane molasses and mild organic agave nectar.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: These distinctive pantry spreads and natural sweeteners elevate morning breakfast and artisan baking!

lessons.name: Seasons & Weather 1
lessons.titleAr: فصول الأرض والمناطق الاستوائية وأجواء السماء اليومية

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Welcome to our climate observatory, where we study Earth's four temperate seasons and tropical weather systems.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I love tracking how green spring transitions into sunny summer, followed by golden autumn and snowy winter!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In the tropics, communities observe a parched dry season, a torrential rainy season, and seasonal monsoon rains.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our astronomical calendar records the spring and autumn equinox, the summer and winter solstice, and the annual agricultural harvest.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And looking out across the valley today, conditions are changing from sunny and cloudy to rainy and windy!

lessons.name: Seasons & Weather 2
lessons.titleAr: التقلبات الجوية القاسية والسلامة من العواصف

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Look at the morning satellite loop: conditions started out foggy and overcast before turning completely clear!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Be cautious, Hana—warm air is making the afternoon uncomfortably humid and stormy.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: When severe squalls hit, blinding lightning flashes across dark clouds followed by rumbling thunder and pounding hail.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Our emergency broadcast center tracks severe weather: a spinning prairie tornado, an ocean hurricane, a freezing blizzard, and a dangerous ice storm.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Civil defense teams also coordinate relief for a river flood, prolonged agricultural drought, and an intense summer heat wave.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our meteorological station utilizes precision instruments to record daily temperature and atmospheric pressure.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Outdoor temperatures range from boiling hot and pleasant warm, to mild, chilly, cool, cold, and freezing below zero.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Inside our control room, we maintain a comfortable room temperature while logging weather readings outside.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: We read ambient degrees on the mercury thermometer, atmospheric pressure on the digital barometer, and wind direction on the rooftop weather vane.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Finally, check the precipitation level in the outdoor rain gauge and record wind speed using the spinning anemometer.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I'm reviewing today's radar loop before we head out on our coastal field expedition!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Dr. Tariq is analyzing the regional synoptic weather map to issue our afternoon weather forecast.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: High-resolution imagery from our geostationary weather satellite confirms incoming rain showers on Doppler radar.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I just received the severe weather alert notification directly on my smartphone weather app!

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Look out at the horizon, Layla! Bright sunshine fills the clear sky with vibrant blue sky color.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Yes, Hana, it is partly cloudy toward the hills with a gentle warm breeze and comfortable dry air.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The weather today is exceptionally calm, with a mild temperature creating pleasant, balmy conditions for our sensors.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: However, yesterday we tracked sudden rain: starting as light drizzle, turning into a torrential downpour, and splashing every street puddle.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The automated drainage canal prevented any serious street flood, keeping our weather station perimeter safe!

lessons.name: The Weather Station 2
lessons.titleAr: عناصر الشتاء والجليد وظواهر ما بعد العاصفة

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Following the thunderstorm, a magnificent seven-colored rainbow arched across the valley.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I grabbed my yellow umbrella, waterproof raincoat, and tall rubber rain boots to inspect the glistening wet road.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: In winter, conditions shift dramatically: falling snow blanketed the station, with each intricate snowflake settling on crisp morning frost.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Freezing sleet and frozen hail formed clear ice across the observation deck, leaving a sharp hanging icicle under the roof.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: During the severe winter snowstorm, thick morning fog covered the nearby frozen pond completely!

lessons.name: The Weather Station 3
lessons.titleAr: المخاطر الجوية الشديدة وصاري أجهزة الاستشعار

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Our station monitors severe weather emergencies, from a raging thunderstorm to extreme atmospheric pressure drops.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Sensors detect jagged lightning, booming thunder, the swirling funnel of a prairie tornado, and the vast eye of an ocean hurricane.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A strong wind can trigger an arid desert dust storm, while prolonged summer heat brings a suffocating heat wave and agricultural drought.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In subpolar regions, a blinding white blizzard challenges meteorological equipment.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our station records every metric: temperature on the thermometer, pressure on the barometer, wind speed on the anemometer, rainfall in the rain gauge, and wind direction on the weather vane.

lessons.name: The Weather Station 4
lessons.titleAr: قياسات الغلاف الجوي العلوي والأقمار والدورات السنوية

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: At zero-six-hundred, right before sunrise, our team launches a high-altitude weather balloon carrying radio telemetry.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: On the telemetry mast, the digital hygrometer measures relative humidity, while the orange wind sock and radar dish track gusting wind speed.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Downlink signals from our polar weather satellite calculate total atmospheric cloud cover across the continent.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: We calibrate these telemetry arrays through spring, summer, autumn, and winter to ensure baseline precision.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Logging daily ambient temperature and barometric trends from golden sunrise until glowing sunset keeps our regional forecasts reliable!

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Good morning! Early dawn reveals sparkling morning dew clinging to the weather station grass.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Over the course of a single week, our logbook recorded sunny, cloudy, rainy, snowy, and windy days.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: When mountain passes become densely foggy or stormy, transport departments rely on our Doppler radar scans.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Integrating real-time radar echoes with thermal satellite imagery guarantees travelers reach their destinations safely!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Welcome to the municipal community center, a vibrant hub designed for education, wellness, and creative arts.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Look at the main facilities: the sports gymnasium, a performance auditorium, a commercial catering kitchen, and an adult education classroom.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Down this creative hallway, we find a messy art room, a soundproof music room, a high-speed computer lab, an executive meeting room, and a quiet reference library.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Parents drop toddlers off at the certified daycare before attending our morning yoga class or energetic dance class.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And on weekends, neighbors enroll in a gourmet cooking class, a watercolor painting class, or an artisan pottery class!

lessons.name: The Community Center 2
lessons.titleAr: دوريات الترفيه والرياضة وأجنحة اللياقة البدنية

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: The evening activity board is packed with educational and physical wellness clubs!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: For academic enrichment, we offer an English language class, one-on-one youth tutoring, evening mindfulness meditation, a monthly book club, and Friday film night.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The sports courts host pickup basketball, competitive volleyball, fast-paced badminton, and indoor table tennis.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Over at the aquatics pavilion, members enjoy lap swimming, while the martial arts studio conducts beginner karate.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Upstairs in the fitness wing, instructors lead upbeat Zumba, step aerobics, dumbbell weight training, and soothing cool-down stretching.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Check the civic bulletin board near the hallway water fountain for this month's upcoming neighborhood events.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: This weekend, volunteers are hosting a charity bake sale, an annual youth talent show, and our seasonal holiday party!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The calendar also includes a financial literacy workshop, a health seminar, an evening orchestral concert, and a local photography exhibition.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Outside on the plaza, farmers set up their weekly farmers market, beside a Red Cross mobile blood drive and polling booths for civic voting.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Store your jacket in a digital locker, rest on the wooden bench, and let's watch the opening ceremony on the main stage!

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I'm testing the ceiling projector and dry-erase whiteboard before the wall clock strikes nine.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Speak clearly into the wireless microphone so every sound is amplified through the wall speaker.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our certified fitness instructor and program coordinator are welcoming every volunteer and registered member.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The facility serves all generations: whether an energetic young child or an active retired senior participating in water aerobics.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Everyone works together: the vigilant pool lifeguard, the youth sports coach, the helpful front receptionist, and the hardworking janitor!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Public safety headquarters coordinates citywide emergency response, crime prevention, and community outreach.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Inside the roll call room, we meet a dedicated police officer, an investigative detective, a duty sergeant, and the precinct police chief.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The communications dispatcher coordinates with a specialized K9 officer, a neighborhood patrol officer, a laboratory forensic analyst, a street traffic officer, and an undercover investigator.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Every officer's duty belt is equipped with a silver identification badge, steel handcuffs, a two-way radio, an emergency flashlight, and a defensive baton.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A highly coordinated team dedicated to upholding community law and public safety!

lessons.name: The Police Station 2
lessons.titleAr: السترات الواقية وأساطيل النجدة والاستجابة للطوارئ

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Officer safety gear and rapid transportation fleets are maintained in the secure precinct garage.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Each officer wears a protective ballistic vest, an active recording body camera, a conductive taser, defensive pepper spray, and a loud traffic whistle.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The vehicle bay houses a marked patrol car, an agile pursuit motorcycle, an aerial surveillance helicopter, a prisoner transport van, and a downtown patrol bicycle.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For specialized operations, they deploy a harbor patrol boat, an all-terrain tactical SUV, a dedicated K9 unit, and an unmarked undercover car.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And for joint medical rescue calls, paramedics dispatch an emergency response ambulance immediately!

lessons.name: The Police Station 3
lessons.titleAr: مرافق المركز وغرفة الأدلة والتحقيقات الجنائية

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Citizens register non-emergency complaints at the front desk before staff file an official incident report.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Behind the secure doors: a temporary holding cell, a soundproof interrogation room, a climate-controlled evidence room, and an officer locker room.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Down the corridor: the emergency dispatch center, a locked equipment armory, the gated vehicle parking lot, a quiet staff break room, and a tactics training room.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Investigators execute a judicial search warrant, lifting a latent fingerprint and securing each clue inside a sealed evidence bag.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: During criminal intake processing, officers document the suspect's digital mugshot into the county registry!

lessons.name: The Police Station 4
lessons.titleEn: Investigative Case Files & Road Safety Controls
lessons.titleAr: ملفات القضايا وضوابط السلامة المرورية في الشارع

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: A detective reviews a confidential case file on the desktop computer, verifying the citizen's government ID card.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The investigating officer notes eyewitness statements in a spiral notebook using an ink pen.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Out on city streets, traffic safety relies on a painted pedestrian crosswalk, an automated traffic light, a posted speed limit, and an octagonal red stop sign.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: When responding to an accident with blaring siren, officers place a steel road barrier, an orange traffic cone, and yellow perimeter caution tape.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A street security camera and commercial intrusion alarm safeguard public corridors 24/7!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: A well-equipped first aid kit is essential for managing minor injuries and medical emergencies.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Inside the red case: a sterile adhesive bandage, rolls of woven cotton gauze, medical adhesive tape, and a disinfecting antiseptic wipe.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For treating lacerations, keep blunt bandage scissors, precision splinter tweezers, a silver safety pin, a flexible elastic bandage, and a triangular bandage for slings.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We also stock a sterile absorbent gauze pad, soothing cooling burn cream, an instant cold pack for swelling, a soothing heat pack, and a padded finger splint.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Having every dressing organized means we can respond promptly and calmly!

lessons.name: The First Aid Room 2
lessons.titleEn: Patient Mobility, Diagnostic Tools & CPR Masks
lessons.titleAr: حركة المريض والأدوات التشخيصية وأقنعة الإنعاش

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our clinical treatment room handles patient triage, mobility assistance, and vital signs assessment.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: For wound care: secure dressings with medical tape, apply soothing antibiotic ointment to prevent infection, and use hydrocortisone cream for itching.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For patient mobility: an emergency folding stretcher, a lightweight wheelchair, an adjustable walking crutch, a rigid limb splint, and a stabilizing cervical neck brace.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Keep a reusable soothing ice pack, an activating hot pack, a cardiac stethoscope, an infrared thermometer, and a fingertip pulse oximeter ready.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Beside the wall-mounted emergency eye wash station hangs a pocket CPR mask for resuscitation!

lessons.name: The First Aid Room 3
lessons.titleAr: كتيبات الإسعاف وضغط الدم ومحاليل التعقيم

script.speaker: Layla
