script.text: Every first responder consults the comprehensive first aid manual while operating diagnostic gear.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Beside the wall-mounted emergency AED defibrillator, we have an automated blood glucose monitor and an inflatable blood pressure cuff.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The triage nurse checks pupillary response with a penlight and inspects the throat using a wooden tongue depressor.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For skin cuts: apply a waterproof plaster, a butterfly strip to close edges, a sterile wound dressing, or rinse with sterile saline solution.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Clean wounds using bubbling hydrogen peroxide, antiseptic brown iodine, a soft cotton swab, powder-free sterile gloves, and an irrigation syringe!

lessons.name: The First Aid Room 4
lessons.titleAr: حالات الطوارئ المتقدمة وأجهزة إزالة الرجفان وحقن الإيبينيفرين

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Critical trauma equipment must be inspected daily to guarantee immediate readiness during crises.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: In advanced wound closure: a sterile minor suture kit, a reinforced wound closure strip, a rapid skin stapler, and a high-flow wound irrigation syringe.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For sanitizing and treating burns: topical rubbing alcohol, water-based burn gel, and antimicrobial iodine solution.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For life-threatening emergencies: an automated cardiac defibrillator, a breathing oxygen mask connected to a pressurized oxygen tank, an emergency epinephrine EpiPen, and a combat tourniquet.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: To prevent shock, wrap the casualty in a reflective silver emergency blanket, blow a loud distress whistle, and signal with a high-beam flashlight!

lessons.name: The First Aid Room 5
lessons.titleAr: مرافق الغرفة السريرية وأجهزة الإنذار ورعاية العمود الفقري

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: In an urgent crisis, lift the red emergency phone or press the wall-mounted emergency alarm button.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: A patient with asthma reaches for a rescue bronchodilator inhaler, while trauma paramedics immobilize the spine using a rigid cervical collar and a full-length spine board.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Outdoor survival supplies include an emergency suction snakebite kit, fine-tip tick remover, and checking the patient's engraved medical ID bracelet.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The treatment cubicle features a padded examination table enclosed by a privacy curtain, beside a handwashing sink and an automatic soap dispenser.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Dry your hands with a clean paper towel, dispose of waste in the foot-pedal waste bin, and lock the wall medicine cabinet securely!

lessons.name: The First Aid Room 6
lessons.titleAr: الملصقات الإرشادية وحاوية الأدوات الحادة والإصابات الشائعة

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: The clinic entryway displays an anatomical wall chart, an analog wall clock, a pump bottle of antibacterial hand sanitizer, and a foldable privacy screen.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Parents fill out an emergency contact card and an official incident report form right below the emergency poison control poster and step-by-step CPR poster.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For safety, check the inspection tag on the chemical fire extinguisher and dispose of used needles safely inside the biohazard sharps container.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: First aiders identify common injuries: a shallow bleeding cut, a purple contusion bruise, and a painful thermal burn.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: More serious athletic trauma includes a twisted ligament ankle sprain or an acute bone fracture requiring an X-ray!

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Outdoor recreation often presents minor mishaps: a dry pinch nosebleed, a painful venomous bee sting, an itchy contact rash, and a friction heel blister.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Use clean tweezers to extract an embedded wooden splinter, but seek emergency help for head trauma causing a suspected concussion or a joint dislocation.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Be alert for sudden loss of consciousness during fainting, perform the Heimlich maneuver for airway choking, and treat a severe anaphylactic allergic reaction promptly.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Environmental extremes can trigger life-threatening heat stroke in summer or dangerous sub-zero hypothermia in winter.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Secure the dressing with medical tape, swab the wound with liquid antiseptic, and support the injured arm in a comfortable canvas sling!

lessons.name: The First Aid Room 8
lessons.titleAr: بروتوكولات الإسعاف الأساسية والإنعاش القلبي الرئوي

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Let us review vital emergency protocols before closing today's clinical first aid practicum.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Always put on protective nitrile gloves, apply a firm sterile compress over bleeding, and begin cardiopulmonary resuscitation CPR if the casualty is unresponsive.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Essential wound care begins when you check pulse rhythms on the carotid artery and firmly apply pressure to control bleeding.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: To minimize swelling and pain, elevate the injured limb above heart level and immobilize any unstable joints with a splint.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Direct a bystander to call emergency services on nine-one-one, then continuously monitor vital breathing signs until paramedics arrive!

lessons.name: The Gas Station 1
lessons.titleEn: Fuel Pumps, Octane Grades & Convenience Snacks
lessons.titleAr: مضخات الوقود ودرجات الأوكتان ووجبات المتجر الخفيفة

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Look up at the glowing digital price sign—fuel rates are quite reasonable today!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Pull the vehicle alongside gas pump four, unscrew the fuel cap, and insert the dispensing nozzle.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Drivers choose between heavy-duty diesel, standard eighty-seven unleaded, or ninety-three octane premium fuel.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Tap your payment card against the contactless card reader, print a paper receipt, and check the dashboard fuel gauge.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: While fueling, let's step inside the convenience store for quick snacks, cold drinks, hot brewed coffee, a bag of ice, and chocolate candy!

lessons.name: The Gas Station 2
lessons.titleEn: Vehicle Fluids, Air Pumps & Convenience Counter
lessons.titleAr: سوائل السيارة ومضخات الهواء وكاونتر المتجر

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: At the convenience checkout counter: grab a bag of salty chips, mint chewing gum, a state lottery ticket, today's morning newspaper, and polarized UV sunglasses.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Over at the service island: pull up to the coin-operated air pump to adjust tire pressure.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Check fluid levels under the hood: pour in blue windshield fluid, top off engine oil using a plastic funnel, and verify engine coolant with winter antifreeze.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: If your wiper blades leave streaks in the rain, replace them right here before entering the automated drive-through car wash.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Finish by using the high-power upholstery vacuum to leave your interior spotless!

lessons.name: The Gas Station 3
lessons.titleAr: مظلة الساحة الخارجية ومرافق المحطة وحركة المركبات

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: The illuminated overhead canopy shields motorists from sudden downpours as they pull into an empty parking spot.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Station amenities include a 24-hour clean restroom, a curbside cash ATM, an outdoor bagged ice machine, a waste dumpster, and a tidy trash can.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: At each fuel pump island, grab the long-handled squeegee, soak it with the water hose, and wipe with an absorbent paper towel.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The busy forecourt accommodates diverse vehicles: a compact family car, a heavy cargo truck, a luxury SUV, an airport passenger van, and a sleek motorcycle.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A bustling multimodal travel hub serving commuters around the clock!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: A wide variety of travelers stop here: a family vacationing in a motorhome RV towing a camping trailer, a tour bus, a commuter sedan, and a sporty open-top convertible.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: The friendly station attendant and store cashier assist every road trip customer with prompt hospitality.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Motorists go through a familiar road sequence: pumping gas into the tank, paying at the register, and fueling efficiently.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Drivers spend five minutes checking oil under the bonnet, filling tires with air, and washing windshield glass until crystal clear.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: With our tank full and vehicle checked, we buckle up and enjoy driving away toward our next destination!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Architectural design requires understanding relative dimensions, scale, and spatial proximity.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Looking across the campus plaza: a big main library contrasts with a small garden kiosk, while a large lecture hall stands next to a tiny espresso booth.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Notice that huge oak tree casting shade over an enormous auditorium, beside miniature bonsai shrubs and medium-sized stone planters.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The promenade features a wide pedestrian avenue that tapers into a narrow brick corridor leading to close park benches.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A building can appear far away across the lake, adjacent to the science pavilion, or distant on the horizon, yet remain easily reachable by a nearby pathway!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Ergonomics and spatial positioning govern accessibility and landscape geometry.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: While mountain cabins sit in remote wilderness, downtown facilities are proximate to transit, keeping daily amenities within reach.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Safety rails ensure hazardous objects remain out of reach of children, while office monitors are kept at arm's length for comfort.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Notice the contrast: a high ceiling and a low coffee table, a tall eucalyptus tree beside a short flowering hedge.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The fountain flows from deep reservoirs into a shallow reflecting pool, across an elevated terrace, a sunken reading courtyard, and a flat level lawn!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Drafting structural plans teaches precision in geometric alignment and spatial organization.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Architects draw horizontal floor beams, vertical support pillars, and diagonal reinforcing trusses across the grid.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: These steel beams run parallel to each other, forming a crisp perpendicular ninety-degree angle with the outer masonry wall.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Check that modular desks are perfectly aligned rather than scattered randomly across the floor, or clustered haphazardly in corners.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Acoustic panels are neatly stacked on pallets and layered across the studio ceiling for maximum sound absorption!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Cartographers combine traditional topographic cartography with satellite navigation arrays.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Examine this printed paper map: interpret the explanatory symbol legend, measure distance using the map scale, and check true north on the compass rose.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The cartographic coordinate grid pinpoints exact latitude and longitude coordinates for any geographic landmark.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Notice the brown elevation contour lines marking mountain summits, alongside the dashed national park boundary line.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: While hiking, navigators triangulate with a handheld GPS receiver, a magnetic compass, orbital satellite telemetry, coastal radar, and optical binoculars!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Navigators verify their bearing using maritime, terrestrial, and vehicular telemetry instruments.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Astronomers peer through an optical telescope, hikers check elevation on a digital altimeter, and drivers monitor vehicle speed on the speedometer and cumulative mileage on the odometer.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A mariner calculates celestial angles using a brass sextant to chart an optimal oceanic route.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: On land, hikers follow a winding forest path, a rocky mountain trail, a scenic trail shortcut, or take an unexpected detour around trail washouts.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: From our expedition origin to our final destination, we log each GPS waypoint, celebrate every ten-mile milestone, and report in at the ranger checkpoint!

lessons.name: Maps & Navigation 3
lessons.titleEn: Digital Navigation Apps, Traffic & Street View
lessons.titleAr: تطبيقات الملاحة الرقمية وحركة المرور والتجوّل الافتراضي

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I'll open our digital navigation app, search for the historical museum, and drop a location pin.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Turn-by-turn voice directions guide our journey, updating real-time highway traffic conditions continuously.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: The app calculates our estimated time of arrival and offers to reroute automatically around highway construction.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Switch between photographic satellite view for terrain and panoramic street view to recognize building entrances.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Finally, let's tap share location with Dr. Tariq so the entire group coordinates seamlessly!

lessons.name: Communication Verbs 1
lessons.titleAr: مستويات الكلام والحوار والتحكم في الصوت

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Effective human interaction requires knowing when to talk quietly, speak formally, or say the right word at the right time.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Can you tell me how to ask thoughtful interview questions and answer them with confidence?

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Allow me to explain grammatical nuance: a lecturer may describe a complex theory, announce a public breakthrough, or declare a formal consensus.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Observe volume control: in a library we whisper secrets or murmur gently, whereas fans in a stadium shout, yell, and scream with excitement!

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Mastering these verbal registers lets us express emotions with absolute clarity!

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: When nervous, speakers might mumble their words, stutter on consonants, or stammer during a difficult presentation.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Yet with vocal training, performers can sing melodious arias and chant choral rhythms with poise.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: In seminar forums, scholars discuss ethical dilemmas and debate opposing perspectives without resorting to petty argue tactics.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Diplomats learn to agree on common ground, respectfully disagree on policy, and negotiate fair compromises.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: To persuade a skeptical committee and convince stakeholders, we must suggest pragmatic steps and propose innovative solutions!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Communication bridges the written word and non-verbal kinesics.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Authors write manuscripts, avid scholars read chapters, office workers type on mechanical keyboards, and we email and text colleagues daily.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Publishers print magazines, publish scholarly books, while professional copyeditors edit chapters, draft introductions, and revise early manuscripts.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Notice body language: speakers gesture with their hands, nod in agreement, shake head in denial, point toward an exhibit, and wave hello.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Combining eloquent prose with expressive gestures enriches every conversation!

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: When words are not enough, body language conveys subtle humor and unspoken meaning.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: When unsure, people shrug their shoulders, while a traffic warden will signal drivers to stop immediately.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: A silent street performer will mime climbing an invisible wall, while hearing-impaired communities sign fluent American Sign Language.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And when sharing a lighthearted secret, Tariq will playfully wink with a warm smile!

lessons.name: Shades & Tones 1
lessons.titleAr: درجات الأحمر القرمزي والفوشيا والأزرق المائي

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Color theory distinguishes nuanced chromatic shades across the spectrum.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: In warm reds and pinks: deep crimson velvet, brilliant scarlet poppies, dark brownish maroon, delicate rose petals, and subtle blush pink.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Notice rich gem tones: vintage burgundy wine, glittering ruby crystals, ripe cherry red, sweet raspberry sorbet, and electric vibrant fuchsia.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Now compare oceanic blues and cool greens: formal dark navy, clear morning sky blue, saturated royal blue, tropical sea aqua, and cooling pastel mint.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Studying these subtle tonal gradations brings artistic precision to fashion and interior design!

lessons.name: Shades & Tones 2
lessons.titleEn: Botanical Greens, Radiant Golds & Warm Bronzes
lessons.titleAr: الأخضر النباتي والأصفر الذهبي والبرونزي الدافئ

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Earth pigments and botanical hues evoke nature's rich mineral palette.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Across verdant greens: brilliant gemstone emerald, earthy muted olive, dense pine forest green, pale oceanic seafoam, and carved Asian jade.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In warm sunlit yellows: shimmering metallic gold, fossilized resin amber, spicy Dijon mustard, sweet golden honey, and tart citrus lemon.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The warm autumnal spectrum includes soft fuzzy peach, vibrant citrus tangerine, oxidized red rust, shimmering metallic copper, and aged bronze statues.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A magnificent spectrum linking botanical greenery with precious metallic luster!

lessons.name: Shades & Tones 3
lessons.titleAr: الألوان المحايدة المعمارية والرماديات والبنفسجي الزهري

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Neutral undertones and floral purples create understated elegance in interior architecture.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: In warm pale neutrals: antique carved ivory, smooth vanilla cream, soft woven beige, sun-bleached desert tan, military cotton khaki, and earthy brownish taupe.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In cool monochrome greys: smoldering dark charcoal, blue-grey roofing slate, pale volcanic ash, and polished sterling silver.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: And for floral elegance: deep rich plum, dusky vintage mauve, fragrant spring lilac, exotic botanical orchid, and dark savory wine.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: These refined shades harmonize beautifully across modern architectural palettes!

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Let us inspect five specialized designer accent colors for contemporary decor.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Designers contrast deep glossy purple eggplant with delicate lavender-blue periwinkle.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: For luxurious neutrals, combine sparkling celebration champagne with warm coastal dune sand and misty atmospheric smoke.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Mastering eggplant, periwinkle, champagne, sand, and smoke enriches our descriptive design vocabulary!

lessons.name: Patterns & Textures 1
lessons.titleEn: Textile Motifs, Geometric Prints & Heritage Weaves
lessons.titleAr: زخارف الأقمشة والأنماط الهندسية والنسيج التراثي

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Textile heritage encompasses traditional repeating motifs, geometric prints, and Scottish weaves.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I love bold fashion prints: classic horizontal striped jerseys, playful polka-dot dresses, Scottish plaid shirts, and black-and-white checkered flags.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In heritage fashion: ornate botanical floral wallpaper, Persian teardrop paisley shawls, sharp geometric tile prints, and colorful abstract artwork.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Observe specialty weaves: military jungle camouflage, retro colorful tie-dye shirts, angled wool herringbone jackets, and jagged houndstooth coats.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For knitwear and picnics, we have diamond argyle socks, Scottish clan tartan kilts, and country picnic red-and-white gingham tablecloths!

lessons.name: Patterns & Textures 2
lessons.titleAr: الملمس الحسي والتشطيبات وتنجيد الأثاث الراقي

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Tactile sensation and fine weave patterns define the character of bespoke fabrics.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Examine tailored prints: a sharp wool pinstripe suit, a zig-zag chevron rug, ornate woven damask drapes, rustic French pastoral toile, and artisanal dyed ikat silks.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Feel the tactile contrasts: glass is completely smooth while unprocessed bark feels rough and unpolished.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A cobblestone path feels bumpy underfoot, whereas plush velvet is soft to touch, contrasting with hard carved granite.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Run your hand across fuzzy woolen mittens, silky smooth scarves, grainy sandpaper, a non-reflective matte finish, and a glossy lacquered cabinet!

lessons.name: Patterns & Textures 3
lessons.titleAr: التشطيبات الحرفية ونقوش المعادن والأنسجة المضلعة

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Material finishing techniques transform raw surfaces into tactile works of art.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Metalworkers craft polished mirror chrome, satin brushed steel, rustic hand-hammered copper bowls, and delicately laser-etched glassware.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Leather artisans create rich embossed book covers with textured raised relief patterns.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In luxury garments: a ribbed corduroy collar, an intricate woven linen tapestry, a warm hand-knitted woolen sweater, and a warm quilted winter parka.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Every finish and weave technique adds unique visual depth and tactile elegance!

lessons.name: Materials 1
lessons.titleEn: Natural Earth Minerals, Timber & Base Metals

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Architecture balances organic natural earth elements with structural metallurgy.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For foundation masonry: solid natural stone, polished Carrara marble, speckled durable granite, porous sedimentary limestone, and blue roofing slate.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: For sustainable timber and ceramics: renewable forest wood, fast-growing bamboo, buoyant oak cork, molded potter's clay, and fine quartz sand.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In structural metals: high-tensile alloy steel, wrought cast iron, lightweight aircraft aluminum, electrical piping copper, and radiant decorative gold.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A magnificent array of building blocks that shape civil engineering and interior craftsmanship!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Fine metallurgy and natural luxury fibers define historic jewelry and couture fashion.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: In precious and alloy metals: lustrous sterling silver, antique copper-alloy bronze, golden musical instrument brass, lightweight aerospace titanium, and durable platinum.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: In natural plant and animal textiles: breathable organic cotton, shimmering mulberry silk, insulating merino wool, and crisp airy flax linen.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Everyday and synthetic fashion includes sturdy blue cotton denim, wrinkle-resistant polyester, and high-strength waterproof nylon.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And for pure luxury: plush theatrical velvet, smooth glossy satin, and ultra-soft Himalayan cashmere!

lessons.name: Materials 3
lessons.titleAr: المواد المركبة الحديثة والبوليمرات والبناء الثقيل

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Modern industrial design utilizes engineered polymers, synthetic composites, and heavy masonry.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Everyday synthetics feature molded rigid plastic, vulcanized elastic rubber, transparent tempered glass, and reinforced lightweight fiberglass.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: High-performance tech uses aerospace carbon fiber, clear shatterproof acrylic, water-resistant vinyl flooring, and flexible heat-resistant silicone.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For cushioning and casting: acoustic polyurethane foam and clear epoxy resin.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For heavy construction: reinforced poured concrete, kiln-fired clay brick, binding grey cement, interior wall plaster, and gypsum drywall sheets!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Let us inspect structural finishing materials used by builders on residential job sites.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Carpenters frame walls with dimensional pine lumber, while masons bond stone blocks with sticky cement mortar.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Tilers lay glazed ceramic tile across the kitchen floor, sealing the joints with waterproof tile grout.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And workers line the attic with thermal fiberglass insulation to maintain steady indoor temperature year-round!

lessons.name: Measurements & Units 1
lessons.titleEn: Linear Metrics, Imperial Yards & Mass Standards
lessons.titleAr: القياسات الخطية والياردة الإمبراطورية ومعايير الكتلة

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Standardized units of measurement ensure scientific precision and international trade compatibility.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: For linear measurements, a wooden school ruler marks each tiny millimeter and centimeter, expanding to a meter and kilometer.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The imperial tape measure calculates lengths in an inch, a twelve-inch foot, a three-foot yard, and a long highway mile.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For mass and weight: pharmaceutical doses require a microscopic milligram, baking recipes measure a gram, and bulk shipping uses a kilogram, a metric ton, and an ounce.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Mastering both metric and imperial units makes global technical calculations straightforward!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Weight scales and volumetric partitives govern kitchen chemistry and fluid transport.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A butcher weighs heavy roasts in a pound, while British medical charts record a patient's weight in stone on a balance scale.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: For liquid volumes: a medicine dropper dispenses a milliliter, beverage cartons hold a liter, and farm dairy tanks store a gallon.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Kitchen volume standards include a quart of broth, a pint of cream, a cup of milk, a tablespoon of olive oil, a teaspoon of salt, and a marked fluid ounce.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For industrial transport, tankers haul crude petroleum in a heavy steel barrel!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Thermal dynamics and chronological time scales govern physical sciences.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Scientists measure heat on the Celsius, Fahrenheit, and scientific Kelvin scales, where each degree signifies thermal kinetic energy.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Water reaches its freezing point at zero degrees and boiling point at one hundred, while healthy human body temperature stabilizes near thirty-seven degrees.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Our laboratory thermometer monitors ambient room temperature constantly to ensure experimental accuracy.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Chronometers record time from a split millisecond, to an exact second, a passing minute, a working hour, and a full solar day!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Kinematics in classical mechanics studies motion and displacement over time.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: While scalar speed measures travel pace, vector velocity includes directional orientation.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: When a vehicle presses forward, acceleration increases its velocity at a constant mechanical rate.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Calculating total travel distance by multiplying travel rate and elapsed time solves every journey problem!

lessons.name: Money & Currency 1
lessons.titleAr: العملات المعدنية والعملات العالمية والحسابات البنكية

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: When we live and work abroad, we use different coins, paper bills, and bank services.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Look at each small metal coin: a copper one-cent penny, a five-cent nickel, a ten-cent dime, and a silver quarter.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Around the world, people pay with the American dollar, the European euro, the British pound, or the Japanese yen.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: At the bank, I opened a new bank account with a savings plan for the future and a checking account for daily expenses.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I need to make a cash deposit today, and tomorrow I will make a quick withdrawal for shopping!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Let's check the price of this item and decide how we want to pay.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I will stop at the ATM to check my account balance and print a monthly bank statement.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: To avoid paying extra credit card interest, I can send a bank transfer or just tap my debit card.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: I take paper cash from my wallet, leave a small tip for the waiter, and put the receipt and my coin change away.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For rent and big services, people still write a bank check or ask for an official invoice!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: It is always smart to make a simple monthly budget and write down every family expense.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: To lower our total cost, we can ask for a discount, wait for a weekend sale, and remember the sales tax.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We want goods that are good and affordable—not too expensive, but also not poorly made and cheap.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Our household income comes from an annual job salary or a fair hourly wage.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Staying free of debt makes it much easier to pay back a student loan and save for a home mortgage!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Every small business needs careful planning to succeed in the market.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We bought good insurance to protect our store and equipment against accidents.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Buying modern tools was a wise investment that saved us a lot of time.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: At the end of the year, our shop made a great profit instead of a loss!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Welcome to our community sports shop! We have gear for every weekend sport.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Look at the balls: a black-and-white soccer ball, an orange basketball, a yellow tennis ball, a hard baseball, and a beach volleyball.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Over here, we have a small golf ball, an oval rugby ball, a red cricket ball, a heavy bowling ball, and a light ping pong ball.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: On this wall, you can choose a tennis racket, a light badminton racket, a wooden baseball bat, a flat cricket bat, or a hockey stick.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: With all this great equipment, we are ready to play outside with our friends!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Staying safe during sports is very important for all athletes.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Here we see a metal golf club, a netted lacrosse stick, a red table tennis paddle, a squash racket, and a long polo mallet.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: To protect your body: put on this sturdy helmet, strap on shin guards, wear soft knee pads, and adjust your elbow pads.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Athletes also wear a rubber mouthguard, clear swim goggles, warm leather gloves, a chest protector, and an athletic cup.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: When you go roller skating, always wear a strong wrist guard to keep your hands safe!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Working out regularly helps us stay healthy, strong, and full of energy.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: For strength: lift a small dumbbell or a heavy barbell, pull an elastic resistance band, skip with a jump rope, and stretch on a blue yoga mat.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: You can also swing a kettlebell, throw a medicine ball, roll on a foam roller, do chin-ups on a pull-up bar, or ride an exercise bike.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: On the court, we set up the volleyball net, check the soccer goal, and shoot at the basketball hoop.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Our coach blows a loud referee whistle and checks our time with a digital stopwatch!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Today is sports day at the track, and everything is ready for the runners.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: We placed bright orange practice cones on the grass and painted clear lane markers along the track.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Each runner steps into a metal starting block, ready to run fast and jump over each hurdle.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Everyone is watching the big electronic scoreboard to see who wins the race!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Welcome to our city sports center! People come here to practice their favorite sports.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Outside on the grass, people play soccer, shoot baskets in basketball, hit balls in volleyball, and play American football and rugby.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In baseball and cricket, players use a wooden bat to hit the hard ball as far as possible.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: On the indoor courts, you can hold a string racket for tennis, play fast badminton, or try table tennis with a friend.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: On weekends, I also enjoy a quiet game of golf outside or an evening of bowling with family!

lessons.name: Sports Center 2
lessons.titleAr: معدات السلامة والجري في المضمار والأهداف

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Before starting any sport, players put on proper safety gear to avoid getting hurt.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Athletes put on a safety helmet, a plastic shin guard for the legs, a soft knee pad, and a baseball glove.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Soccer players kick into the net to score a goal, while basketball players aim for the high hoop.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: On the running track, runners practice sprinting, team relay race passing, and leaping over red hurdles.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The referee stands near the orange cone, blows his whistle, stops his stopwatch, and checks the scoreboard!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: The sports center hosts exciting competitions for both track athletes and swimmers.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: On the field, we watch the sand long jump, the bar high jump, the long javelin throw, the discus, and the high pole vault.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Distance runners leave the starting block to run a full marathon all the way to the finish line.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Inside the indoor swimming pool, divers jump from the diving board, and swimmers stay inside each marked lane.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I put on my swim cap, hold a foam kickboard, and practice my backstroke and fast freestyle!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our building has great facilities for every kind of indoor and outdoor exercise.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: In the water, swimmers practice the strong butterfly stroke, play a game of water polo, or do graceful synchronized swimming.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: In the main gymnasium, fans sit on high bleachers, players rest on a wooden bench, boxers spar in the boxing ring, and wrestlers train on a soft mat.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Outside, we have a running track, a green soccer field, and a hard tennis court.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I run on a treadmill in the weight room, change in the locker room, and take a warm shower before going home!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Team sports teach us how to practice together, help our friends, and play fair.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Before we play, every athlete must do a quick warm-up and stretch their arms and legs.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Our friendly coach gives instructions, the official referee watches the game, and every teammate works together.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Now let's practice: dribble the ball, pass to your friend, kick to the goal, throw across the court, and catch with two hands.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: When we play as a team, we can win the game and get the highest score!

lessons.name: Beach 1
lessons.titleEn: At the Coast, Waves & Sun Protection
lessons.titleAr: على الساحل والأمواج والوقاية من الشمس

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: What a beautiful sunny day to visit the beach and relax near the water!

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I love walking on the warm sand along the shore, watching each blue wave roll in beneath the tall rocky cliff and sand dune.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Look towards the far horizon: small fish swim in that rocky tide pool, near the coral reef in the quiet cove, across the wide bay, and inside the calm lagoon.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Let's put down this big beach towel, open our sun umbrella, and put on sunscreen so we do not get burned.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The blue ocean looks so peaceful and clear today!

lessons.name: Beach 2
lessons.titleAr: ملابس السباحة والنظارات الشمسية والمرح في الماء

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Make yourself comfortable! We have cold drinks in the cooler and chairs ready.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I will sit on this folding beach chair, leave my flip-flops on the sand, and wear my dark sunglasses and a wide sun hat.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: People wear different clothes for the beach, like a one-piece swimsuit, a two-piece bikini, or blue board swim trunks.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: To see underwater, put on swim goggles or breathe through a snorkel while kicking with rubber fins.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: There is so much to do here: easy swimming, wave surfing, shallow reef snorkeling, and deep sea diving!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Look at everyone having fun with water sports and games along the shore!

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Out in the sea: some people try sea kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, small boogie boarding, or fast jet skiing.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Others love small boat sailing, windy windsurfing, water skiing behind a motorboat, or quiet morning fishing.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: On the sand, children build a tall sandcastle, friends throw a flying frisbee, and teams play friendly beach volleyball.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: I also love quiet sunbathing, having a fruit picnic, kite flying in the breeze, and shell collecting by the water!

lessons.name: Beach 4
lessons.titleAr: الحيوانات البحرية والطيور ونار الشاطئ المسائية

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: The ocean is full of wonderful animals and birds living close to the shore.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Look up at that noisy white seagull, see that little crab walking sideways, find a starfish on the rock, and stay away from that clear jellyfish.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Further out, we can spot a friendly dolphin jumping, a sea turtle swimming, a big brown pelican, a tiny seahorse, and a clam shell on the coral reef.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: In the late afternoon, people enjoy quiet book reading, walking along the water, or evening jogging on the hard sand.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Let's cook dinner on the beach barbecue and sit around a warm bonfire as the sun goes down!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Always check the safety rules and facilities before going into the water.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Watch your step on wet rocks: slippery brown seaweed and sharp black sea urchins can hurt your feet.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A trained lifeguard sits up in the lifeguard tower, flies a yellow warning flag, and keeps a first aid kit ready for emergencies.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: After swimming, you can wash off salt under an outdoor shower and change your clothes in the private changing room.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Now let's walk down the wooden boardwalk out onto the long pier, put our trash in the trash can, and head to the parking lot!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Here we are at the amusement park! There are so many exciting rides to try today.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Look at that giant roller coaster: people scream on the tall drop tower, turn upside down on the loop ride, shoot forward on the fast launch coaster, and swing on the big pendulum ride!

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Over there, people enjoy a dizzy spinning ride, splash down the water slide and log flume, rock on the pirate ship, or ride high on the gentle Ferris wheel.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For easier rides: ride a wooden horse on the carousel, bump friends in bumper cars, race fast go-karts, take a calm train ride, or spin inside colorful tea cups.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Everyone is having fun, smiling, and laughing in the sunshine!

lessons.name: The Amusement Park 2
lessons.titleEn: Carnival Games, Haunted Houses & Big Prizes
lessons.titleAr: ألعاب الكرنفال وبيوت الرعب والجوائز الكبيرة

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: This walkway has all the classic carnival games and fun attractions.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: We can fly in circles on the flying swings, take a quiet boat ride, ride the high monorail, explore the dark haunted house, or laugh in the silly mirror fun house.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Let's try our luck: throw rings in ring toss, pop balloons in balloon dart, shoot in the basketball throw, and grab a prize in the claw machine.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: You can also hit targets in whack-a-mole, hit the bell on the strength test, or squirt water in the water gun game.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: When you win, go to the prize booth to pick a cute stuffed animal or even a giant teddy bear!

lessons.name: The Amusement Park 3
lessons.titleEn: Sweet Snacks, Food Stands & Park Services
lessons.titleAr: الوجبات الخفيفة وأكشاك الطعام وخدمات الحديقة

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: When you enter through the main entrance gate, you can find helpful services right away.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: We bought our passes at the ticket booth, checked ride locations on the map board, found a clean restroom, and saw the first aid station.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Now let's get some sweet treats: pink cotton candy, warm funnel cake, salty popcorn, a sweet cinnamon churro, and a shiny red candy apple.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For lunch, you can eat a hot corn dog, enjoy a warm soft pretzel, eat an ice cream cone, drink cold lemonade, or taste an ice snow cone.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: These delicious snacks give us plenty of energy to ride more attractions all afternoon!

lessons.name: The Amusement Park 4
lessons.titleAr: المواكب والفنانون المتجولون والألعاب النارية المسائية

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: In the evening, the main street fills with music, live shows, and happy crowds.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Children wave to the friendly park mascot, look up at the tall stilt walker, watch a juggler throw three balls, and visit the face painter for colorful face paint.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Near the water fountain, a funny street performer entertains the crowd, a clever magician does card tricks, and dancers perform an energetic dance show on the outdoor stage.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: A loud marching band plays during the evening parade, right in front of the popular photo spot, the souvenir shop, and the lost and found desk.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: To end the magical night, bright and colorful fireworks explode high in the dark sky!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Having a good day at the park is easy when you have your passes and a plan.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: We showed our entry ticket at the gate, put on a blue wristband for all-day rides, and checked our paper park map to see every area.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: My favorite parts were racing around the bend in a go-kart, flying high on the swing ride, and watching a fun stage show.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We saw a colorful dragon parade float pass by while playing fun video games inside the bright arcade.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Before we go, let's take funny pictures in the photo booth and buy a little souvenir to remember this day!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: In our first aid class today, we are learning how to examine a person's head and face after an accident.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: First check the hard skull: gently touch the scalp, check the crown of the head, and feel the soft temple near the forehead.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Next, ask the patient to open their lower jaw and point to their chin, then check for soreness around the neck and throat.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Now look closely at each eye: raise the hairy eyebrow, lift the upper eyelid, check each tiny eyelash, and shine a light to see if the dark pupil responds.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: When you know these parts well, you can describe any injury clearly to the doctor!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: During a routine checkup, the doctor inspects our eyes, nose, and mouth to make sure everything is healthy.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Inside the protective eye socket: the clear cornea covers the colored iris, tears drain through the tear duct, and the back retina catches the light.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: On the nose, the doctor feels the bony bridge of the nose and checks inside each nostril to see if breathing is clear.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Now open your mouth wide: relax your upper lip and lower lip, stick out your tongue, and let us look at the roof palate and pink gums.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Everything looks very clean, healthy, and well-cared for today!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our ears help us hear and keep our balance, while our teeth help us chew healthy food every day.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Looking at the ear: the outer ear catches each sound wave, which travels down the ear canal to vibrate the thin eardrum, while the soft earlobe hangs below.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Deep in the inner ear, the spiral cochlea gives us the gift of hearing and helps our body keep steady balance.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Now let's count each tooth: in front, the sharp incisor and pointed canine cut food, while the wide premolar and flat back molar grind it down.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Brushing twice a day protects our teeth and keeps our smile strong and bright!

lessons.name: The Human Body (Head & Face) 4
lessons.titleAr: جذور الأسنان وتسريحات الشعر وشعر الوجه

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: As we grow from children into adults, our teeth and hair change in natural ways.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Children lose each small baby tooth, while adults grow a back wisdom tooth protected by hard white enamel and anchored by a deep root.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For styling head hair: the barber trims along the natural hairline, combs a neat side part, checks each strand, and weaves a tight braid.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For men's facial grooming: some grow a full beard, a neat mustache, trimmed sideburns, morning stubble, or a small goatee around the chin.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A clean trim and fresh haircut always make you feel confident and ready for the day!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: When we begin a physical fitness checkup, we examine the chest, arms, and torso muscles.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Place your hands on your broad chest: feel the protective ribcage, the center bone sternum, the female breast, the curved collarbone, and the throat Adam's apple.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Lower down, relax your abdomen: measure your narrow waist with a tape, check your round belly, and find your center belly button navel.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Now raise each shoulder: lift your armpit, flex the front bicep and back tricep along your strong upper arm.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Keeping these muscles strong gives us great posture and plenty of energy throughout the day!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Good posture protects our back bones and joints when we lift heavy items at work.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Move your entire arm: flex the shoulder deltoid, bend your joint elbow, rotate your lower forearm, and turn your flexible wrist.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Along your back: feel the long spine made of each bony vertebra, check your upper back, mid back, and lower back, and trace each side rib and flat shoulder blade.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: At the base of the back, the bottom tailbone connects into the wide pelvis ring and supportive side hip joint.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Gentle daily stretching keeps your spine flexible and prevents lower back pain!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Athletic conditioning strengthens our core muscles and tendons while keeping our skin healthy.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: In the chest and stomach: train the front pectoral chest muscle, tighten your abdominal wall, and twist your side oblique muscles for a strong core.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: On your back and arms: strengthen your neck trapezius, pull with the broad latissimus, rotate the shoulder rotator cuff, and protect each flexor and extensor tendon.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Now look at your outer skin: wash each tiny sweat pore, and check whether that spot is a sun freckle, a dark brown mole, or a natural birthmark.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Taking care of both muscles and skin is the best way to feel great every day!

lessons.name: The Human Body (Upper Body) 4
lessons.titleAr: تفاعلات الجلد والشفاء والعناية من الشمس

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our skin reacts quickly to cold air, strong sunlight, and minor injuries.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: When a cold wind blows, you can see tiny goosebumps rise up on your arms.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Enjoying the sun gives you a golden tan, but staying out too long without sunscreen causes a painful red sunburn.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Good moisturizing cream helps heal an old cut scar and keeps the skin smooth without an early age wrinkle!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Strong legs help us walk, run, and carry ourselves comfortably throughout our daily activities.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Feel your upper pelvis: place your hands on the top iliac crest, rotate your flexible hip joint, stretch your front hip flexor, and be mindful of your sensitive groin.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Along your strong upper leg thigh: the long bone femur is protected by the front quadricep, the back hamstring, the inner thigh, and the outer thigh.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Bend your lower knee: gently press the floating kneecap, feel the front bone shin and long tibia, and massage the back muscle calf.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Stretching your legs after exercise prevents muscle stiffness and keeps you moving easily!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our feet and ankles bear the entire weight of our body with every step we take.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: In the lower leg: the thin side bone is the fibula, the knee cushion is the meniscus and popliteal space behind, supported by each strong ligament.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Down at the ankle: feel the round ankle bone on each side, the thick back Achilles tendon, and the cushioned back heel.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Look at the bottom foot: examine the flat sole, the curved arch, the top instep, the padded ball of the foot, the bottom plantar fascia, and each long metatarsal bone.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Wearing supportive running shoes protects your arches and prevents sore feet after long walks!

lessons.name: The Human Body (Lower Body) 3
lessons.titleAr: أصابع القدم والعناية بالقدم وتمارين الساقين

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Taking good care of your toes and nails prevents common foot problems and discomfort.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Check each toe: from the wide big toe to the small little toe, inspect each soft toe pad, flex each toe joint, and trim the toenail, cuticle, and pink nail bed carefully.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Tight shoes can cause a painful side bunion, hard yellow skin callus, or a fluid-filled friction blister that needs to heal.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: To build strength: walk briskly in the morning, run in the park, jump over obstacles, bend deep in a gym squat, and step forward into a lunge.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Active daily movement keeps our joints young and our legs full of power!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our lower body allows us to perform many different natural movements and positions.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: In soccer, players kick the ball with great power and take a long running stride across the grass.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: When picking up gear, players crouch down close to the ground or kneel on one knee to tie their laces.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And when moving quietly across the floor, we balance on our tiptoe so nobody hears us!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our human hand is an amazing tool that allows us to write, hold objects, and work with great precision.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Look at your hand: turn over the flat open palm to see the back of the hand, bend your flexible wrist, and press each bony knuckle.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: We name each finger: the strong side thumb, the pointing index finger, the tall middle finger, the wedding ring finger, and the small little finger.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: At each sensitive fingertip, you have a unique spiral fingerprint, protected by a hard finger nail and a thin skin cuticle.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Keeping our hands clean and moisturized protects our skin throughout busy work days!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Hand exercises improve dexterity, joint flexibility, and everyday grip strength.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: In the hand skeleton: each finger bone is a phalanx connected at a movable joint, linked by skin webbing, palm crease lines, and the curved palm lifeline.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Try these actions: test your firm grip on a ball, pinch a coin with two fingers, grasp a handle, squeeze a soft sponge, and tightly clench your fingers together.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Now communicate with gestures: point forward, snap your fingers to the music, wave hello to a friend, clap your hands in applause, or make a solid fist.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Our hands speak their own expressive language in every culture around the world!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Regular foot and hand care keeps our skin soft, clean, and free of painful calluses.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Examining the foot: feel the round ankle bone, the back heel, the flat bottom sole, the curved arch, the top instep, the foot bridge, the padded ball, and each toe.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: At the salon: clients enjoy a soothing hand manicure and a relaxing foot pedicure to trim each toenail neatly.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The specialist shapes rough edges with a sandpaper nail file, applies soothing scented lotion, and paints shiny colored nail polish.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Your feet and hands feel completely refreshed, smooth, and revitalized after this treatment!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Having a daily skincare routine protects our hands and feet from harsh weather.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: In the shower, apply a gentle scrub exfoliant and rub your heels with a natural volcanic pumice stone to remove rough skin.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: After drying, nourish dry cuticles with vitamin cuticle oil and massage your palms with a rich, protective hand cream.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Applying a daily hydrating skin moisturizer keeps your hands feeling comfortable and healthy all day long!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: When meeting visitors at the busy airport, it helps to describe their height and build accurately.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: My friend is tall and slim with dark straight hair, while her sister is short, petite, and has springy curly hair.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Our guide is of average height and quite athletic, walking beside a muscular athlete with thick hair and a heavy stocky builder.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Looking across the crowd: some people have gentle wavy hair, while older travelers often have thin hair and a thin frame.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: There they are by the exit door! Clear descriptions make spotting friends so easy!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: People have different hair textures and natural colors from heritage and family.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Some clients have fine hair or soft silky hair, while others manage frizzy hair, thick coarse hair, or tight textured hair.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Across natural shades: we see golden blonde, deep brown brunette, shiny black hair, fiery red hair, and rich reddish-brown auburn.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: With age, many people proudly wear natural gray hair or white hair, while others prefer bright highlighted strands or dyed hair over their natural color.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Whatever color or texture you have, good care keeps your hair looking healthy and vibrant!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: In this old family portrait, you can see all our different hairstyles and eye colors.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Aunt Sarah wears a high ponytail and a neat braid, grandmother pins a classic bun, and my little sister wore playful pigtails with front bangs.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Here is uncle with a modern bob cut, my cousin with a short military crew cut, brother with a rounded afro, his friend with dreadlocks, and grandpa smiling completely bald.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Notice their eyes: father has clear blue eyes, mother has warm brown eyes, my aunt has emerald green eyes, cousin has golden hazel eyes, and our grandfather had gentle gray eyes.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Looking through these photos reminds us of our family's unique heritage and warm memories!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: In portrait drawing, capturing facial shapes and distinct features brings the sketch to life.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: First draw the eyes: they can be deep dark eyes or pale light eyes, almond-shaped or large round eyes, and sometimes wide-set apart.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Now shape the head: choose between a soft round face or an elegant oval face, sketch a firm square jaw, and shade prominent high cheekbones.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Add unique details: charming smile dimples, sun freckles across the cheeks, a gentle double chin or a cleft chin, a prominent nose, and soft full lips.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Every person has their own distinctive combination of features that makes them special!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Choosing the right daily skincare begins with knowing your specific skin type and complexion.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: People have oily skin, tight dry skin, combination skin, easily irritated sensitive skin, or balanced normal skin.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We care for teen acne-prone skin and aging mature skin across fair skin, rich dark skin, and golden olive skin tones.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Soothing creams help treat facial acne breakouts, itchy eczema, a red allergic rash, painful summer sunburn, and a shoe friction blister.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Drinking enough water and gentle washing keep your skin healthy in every season!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Targeted hair products and skin balms restore moisture and protect against everyday stress.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: To help skin heal: apply vitamin oil to a purple bruise, an old healed scar, a postpartum stretch mark, forehead wrinkles, or a rough dry patch.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: In the shower: cleanse with a gentle shampoo, soften with rich conditioner, and nourish once a week with an intensive hair mask.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For styling: apply a moisturizing serum or argan hair oil, spray quick dry shampoo, comb through a leave-in detangler, and finish with holding hair spray or volumizing mousse.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: With the right products, your hair stays silky, manageable, and easy to style!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Getting ready in the morning involves standard styling tools and a simple skincare routine.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: To style your hair: untangle with a wide comb or soft brush, dry with an electric hair dryer, straighten with a flat iron, or make waves with a hot curling iron.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Hold the style in place with a decorative hair clip, a discreet black bobby pin, an elastic hair tie, a comfortable cloth headband, or a bouncy hair roller.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For your face: wash with a gentle cleanser, balance with a toner, smooth on a hydrating moisturizer, protect with daily sunscreen, and scrub weekly with a mild exfoliant.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Following these simple steps keeps you looking neat, fresh, and feeling confident all day!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Before going to sleep, evening skincare repairs our skin overnight while we rest.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Relax for fifteen minutes with a soothing clay face mask and dab hydrating lip balm over dry lips.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Gently pat a cooling eye cream around the eyelids and massage a rich, restorative night cream across the face and neck.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: You wake up in the morning feeling completely refreshed, with soft and glowing skin!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Watching our family grow reminds us of the wonderful stages of human development and childhood.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: My cousin holds her sleeping newborn baby and bottle-fed infant, while an active walking toddler chases a preschooler across the lawn.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Every young child, playful kid, and energetic youngster experiences rapid physical growth and happy learning during their early years.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Over by the pavilion: every teenager and adolescent teen navigates the changes of puberty and the adventures of energetic youth.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Each phase of life brings its own unique joys, friendships, and new discoveries!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: As young people transition into adulthood, they take on greater independence and civic responsibility.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: After a sudden teen growth spurt, a minor passes legal juvenile years to celebrate their coming of age as an independent young adult.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Now a fully responsible grown-up and adult in the prime of life, one builds a career before becoming a mature, middle-aged leader.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Our community benefits from each experienced professional mentor who works alongside our respected elderly citizens.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Learning from different generations gives us valuable perspective and builds a stronger society!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Every human journey is marked by memorable personal milestones and the gift of longevity.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: From a baby's joyful birth, wobbly first steps, and sweet first words, to school start, high school graduation, and earning a first job!

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Decades later, after a successful career, a proud retiree enjoys well-deserved retirement during their peaceful golden years.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Through the natural process of aging, each loving grandparent, senior citizen, and community elder shares deep life wisdom.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We honor the stories, knowledge, and kindness that our elders pass down to us!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Building a loving family creates enduring memories that last for generations.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: A happy marriage brings two families together in mutual love, trust, and shared dreams.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Embracing the responsibilities of parenthood teaches patience, selflessness, and unconditional care.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The greatest legacy parents can leave their children is a good education, strong values, and a kind heart!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: When packing for our trip, we need comfortable everyday clothes for warm days and cool evenings.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I packed a casual cotton t-shirt, an elegant silk blouse, a warm wool sweater, an oversized hoodie, and a summer tank top.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For smart casual wear: I chose a collared button shirt, a knit polo shirt, a buttoned cardigan, a warm knitted pullover, and a smart quilted vest.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For bottoms: we have durable blue jeans, formal trousers pants, summer walking shorts, an A-line skirt, and stretchy black leggings.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Mixing and matching these pieces gives us dozens of great outfit combinations!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: The weather forecast predicts rain and chilly winds, so reliable outerwear is essential.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Look at the trousers: comfortable gray sweatpants for lounging, pocketed cargo pants, classic beige khakis, cropped capris, and wide-leg culottes.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For daytime wear: grab a light jacket, put on a sharp business blazer, wear a classic beige trench coat, or layer a casual denim jacket.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: When it turns stormy: put on a long winter coat, a waterproof raincoat, a light running windbreaker, an insulated heavy parka, a puffy puffer jacket, and a soft warm fleece.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Layering these warm jackets keeps us completely dry and comfortable in any weather!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Choosing the right outfit depends on the occasion, whether it is a garden party or daily work.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I love this floral dress: compare the breezy beach sundress, an elegant floor-length maxi dress, a party mini dress, a tailored jumpsuit, and a casual summer romper.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For practical wear: farmers wear denim overalls, athletes run in a matching tracksuit, students wear their school uniform, and babies sleep in a soft cotton onesie.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Never forget daily basics: fresh clean underwear, a supportive bra, cotton socks, a white undershirt, and breathable boxer shorts.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: When you have the right basics, getting dressed every morning is quick and effortless!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: After a long busy day, there is nothing better than changing into cozy home loungewear.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I changed into my soft striped pajamas, while grandmother prefers a light cotton nightgown.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: After a hot shower, wrap up in a plush bathrobe or tie on a silk robe, and slip your feet into warm slippers.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Sitting by the fireplace in cozy slippers is the perfect way to relax before bedtime!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Accessories add personality, color, and practical protection to any simple outfit.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Look at the headwear: a summer sun hat, a baseball cap, a warm knit beanie, a French wool beret, a sports headband, a hair clip, a glittering bridal tiara, a traditional turban, an athletic visor, and a stylish felt fedora.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In the glass jewelry case: admire this gold necklace with a crystal pendant, a tight velvet choker, a silver chain, and a matching wrist bracelet.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Each piece shows beautiful craftsmanship, whether worn for a formal gala or everyday wear.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Adding the right hat and necklace completely transforms your entire look!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Fine jewelry often celebrates special life milestones and timeless commitments.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: For the wrist: wear a solid gold bangle, an automatic watch, an active silicon wristband, a wide shirt cuff, or a silver charm bracelet.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: On the fingers: a diamond engagement ring, a plain gold wedding band, an engraved family signet ring, or a fashion gemstone ring.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For the ears: choose a simple earring with a diamond stud, a classic silver hoop, an elegant dangle earring, a clip-on ear cuff, or a stylish ear piercing.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: These treasured pieces become family heirlooms that people cherish for decades!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Carrying the right bag makes traveling through airports and cities very comfortable.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Choose your bag: a leather handbag, a school backpack, a spacious canvas tote bag, a cross-body messenger bag, or an evening clutch.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Keep money inside your leather wallet and coin purse, carry work files in a briefcase, pack gym clothes in a duffel bag, and clip on a fanny pack for hands-free walks.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Do not forget essentials: UV sunglasses for sunny streets, reading glasses, a warm wool scarf, leather gloves for chilly mornings, and a sturdy waist belt.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: With all our bags packed and organized, we are ready for a wonderful day out!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Vintage accessories carry timeless elegance and classic historic charm.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Look at this sparkling crystal brooch pinned to the lapel, and a gentleman's gold tie pin securing his silk necktie.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: An antique grandfather pocket watch ticks inside its brass case, beside a polished wooden walking cane.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And by the door stands a sturdy black umbrella, ready to keep us dry whenever rain begins to fall!

lessons.name: Footwear 1
lessons.titleEn: Sneakers, Casual Slip-Ons & Formal Dress Shoes
lessons.titleAr: الأحذية الرياضية والأحذية المريحة والأحذية الرسمية

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Finding comfortable footwear is essential whether you are walking city streets or attending a formal dinner.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: For casual comfort: I love white athletic sneakers, light canvas shoes, easy elastic slip-ons, rope-soled summer espadrilles, soft suede moccasins, and nautical boat shoes.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For urban street style: younger shoppers choose tall platform shoes, basketball high-tops, everyday low-tops, and flat rubber skate shoes.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For professional business: gentlemen wear polished leather oxford shoes, classic derby shoes, slip-on leather loafers, decorative wingtip brogues, and buckle monk strap shoes.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Trying on both shoes and walking around ensures you get the exact right fit and comfort!

lessons.name: Footwear 2
lessons.titleEn: Heels, Winter Boots & Heavy Outdoor Footwear
lessons.titleAr: الأحذية ذات الكعب العالي والأحذية الشتوية والأحذية المتينة

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Different occasions require specific heels and weather-resistant boots.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: For evening galas: women choose classic pumps, tall pencil stilettos, comfortable lower kitten heels, steady square block heels, and elegant formal dress shoes.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For autumn fashion: try stylish leather ankle boots, tall leather knee-high boots, rugged lace-up combat boots, elastic-sided Chelsea boots, and western cowboy boots.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For tough weather and work: pull on waterproof rubber rain boots, warm insulated snow boots, mountain trail hiking boots, steel-toe work boots, and equestrian riding boots.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: With sturdy hiking boots and warm socks, you can conquer any trail in rain or snow!

lessons.name: Footwear 3
lessons.titleAr: الصنادل والنعال الصيفية وأحذية الملاعب الرياضية

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Warm summer days call for open sandals, while athletic workouts require sport-specific grip.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: At the beach and pool: wear open sandals, casual rubber flip-flops, easy slip slides, knee-high gladiator sandals, cork wedges, tall platform sandals, and delicate strappy sandals.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For casual strolls: woven leather huaraches, wooden garden clogs, and backless slip-on mules offer great comfort and airflow.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: For sports: lace up cushioned marathon running shoes, versatile gym cross-trainers, high-traction basketball shoes, studded grass soccer cleats, and durable court tennis shoes.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Having the proper athletic shoes prevents sports injuries and improves your personal best!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Specialized sports and performing arts demand shoes designed for unique surfaces.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Rock climbers grip tiny cliff edges in tight rubber climbing shoes, while cyclists clip into road pedals using rigid cycling shoes.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Performers glide across wooden stages in flexible leather dance shoes, and players slide smoothly down the lane in rented bowling shoes.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: And when you finally get home after a busy day, nothing beats sliding your tired feet into warm, soft slippers!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our large family tree brings together four wonderful generations under one roof.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I love visiting my grandmother and grandfather: we call them grandma and grandpa, or warmly nana and papa, while my little sister calls our elder granny.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We are blessed to still have our great-grandmother and great-grandfather sharing stories as our oldest living grandparent.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In the garden: my aunt and uncle are laughing with every cousin, including my first cousin and our distant second cousin.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Having a big extended family means there is always warmth, laughter, and support whenever we meet!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: When two people marry, their families unite and form lasting bonds with all the in-laws.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I hugged my great-aunt and great-uncle, played games with my young niece and energetic nephew, and greeted my cousin-in-law.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: My wife's parents are my kind mother-in-law and helpful father-in-law, and her siblings are my sister-in-law and brother-in-law.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Our parents warmly welcomed their new son-in-law and daughter-in-law, connecting our spouse's family, extended in-laws, and entire family-in-law together.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Our family circle keeps growing bigger and friendlier with every passing year!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Family traditions keep relatives connected across cities and countries through shared celebrations.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: We host an annual summer family reunion, sit down for a warm holiday dinner, roast turkey at Thanksgiving, exchange gifts at Christmas, and paint eggs at Easter.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Throughout the year, we gather for each birthday celebration, honor our grandparents' golden wedding anniversary, and dance at every big family wedding.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: When the weather is sunny, we fire up the grill for an afternoon backyard barbecue and pack sandwiches for a lakeside picnic.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: These joyful gatherings create memories that we treasure for the rest of our lives!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Our lives are enriched by many kinds of friendships and supportive social relationships.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: I introduced my childhood friend and lifelong best friend to a friendly acquaintance from school, an old university classmate, and my office colleague.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Around our neighborhood: I chat with my next-door neighbor, train with my sports teammate, share chores with my apartment roommate, and write letters to an overseas pen-pal.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In personal life: a loyal companion walks beside you, whether as a business partner, a loving spouse, a caring husband and wife, or a supportive boyfriend.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Building trust and staying in touch keeps all these relationships strong and meaningful!

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Balancing professional careers with personal romance shapes our everyday adult life.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: At the party: my brother introduced his lovely girlfriend, a happy couple toasted their fiancé and fiancée, while partners celebrated finding their significant other and true soulmate.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: In the office hierarchy: the company boss and division manager guide each dedicated employee, while the team supervisor oversees our summer college intern.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A skilled senior mentor guides a technical apprentice, while the executive assistant coordinates with the managing director and project coordinator.

script.speaker: Adam
