script.text: Technicians calibrated the overhead lighting-rig, tuned the dynamic surround sound-system, and projected visuals against the stage backdrop.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Ushers escorted dignitaries into the tiered VIP-section seating before the show commenced.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Model casting and final gown fitting culminated in a full choreography rehearsal, followed by backstage hair-styling and makeup.

lessons.titleEn: Fashion Weeks, Capital Capitals & Couture Maisons
lessons.titleAr: أسابيع الموضة وعواصم الأزياء ودور الكوتور العريقة

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Dressers assist rapid model dressing in the backstage lineup minutes before the curtain opens.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Models synchronized their pacing to dramatic runway choreography and energetic curated music-selection.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Exquisite gilded invitations summoned global fashion editors to kick off international Fashion Week.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The seasonal tour moves rapidly from New York to London, then onto Milan and Paris.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: The visionary creative designer cemented their heritage brand, establishing a signature luxury label for the historic couture house and Parisian maison.

lessons.titleEn: Fashion Journalism, Street Style & Red Carpets
lessons.titleAr: صحافة الموضة وإطلالات الشارع والسجادة الحمراء

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: A prominent fashion editor scribbled show impressions for an international glossy magazine.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: A street style photographer snapped avant-garde guest ensembles outside the main entrance.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Editors published a glowing critical review alongside extensive live runway coverage.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Content creators uploaded livestream video across social media, reaching viral fashion blog followers.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: A prominent digital influencer arrived in a bespoke gown destined for tomorrow's celebrity red carpet.

lessons.name: The Vineyard 1
lessons.titleAr: التربة والمناخ والزراعة وأصناف العنب المميزة

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Our terraced hillside slope captures optimal sunlight, giving this unique terroir an exceptional mineral character across every vineyard row.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: We train each delicate vine along a sturdy vertical trellis to ensure maximum sun exposure for our prized Cabernet Sauvignon and velvety Merlot.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Further down the cooler microclimate, vibrant Chardonnay and delicate Pinot Noir flourish alongside aromatic Sauvignon Blanc.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: In the gravelly sector, hearty Riesling and spicy Syrah thrive, while high-altitude plots yield robust Argentine Malbec.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We also cultivate Spanish Tempranillo and bold, heritage Zinfandel to craft deeply nuanced single-estate vintages.

lessons.name: The Vineyard 2
lessons.titleAr: دورة حياة الكروم وإدارة المجموع الخضري وموسم الحصاد

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: During winter dormancy, vineyard workers perform meticulous vine pruning and practice grafting on hardy root-stock to sustain healthy vines.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: With spring warming, delicate bud-break signals early flowering and the start of a vigorous growing season.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: We deploy active frost-protection sprinklers and automated drip irrigation to safeguard the lush vegetative canopy.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Protective overhead bird netting preserves grape clusters as veraison transforms green berries into deep purple jewels.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: When sugar levels peak, the harvest commences with careful hand-picking, rushing prime clusters straight to the crush pad.

lessons.name: The Vineyard 3
lessons.titleAr: فريق المزرعة وعلم الخمور وشبكات التوزيع

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Our head viticulturist coordinates closely with the vineyard manager to monitor vine nutrition and soil health.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: At dawn, an experienced seasonal harvest crew gathers the fruit while our master cooper repairs toasted oak casks.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Inside the laboratory, the resident enologist tests sugar chemistry, advising our chief winemaker and visionary vintner.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Down in the barrels, the seasoned cellar master oversees barrel aging before releasing lots to a distinguished Bordeaux négociant.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Finally, our resident head sommelier curates prestigious pairings and presents these cellar reserves to visiting connoisseurs.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Gentle grape crushing inside an industrial crusher releases fresh free-run juice, followed by pressing inside a modern pneumatic wine-press.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Cooling jackets on each stainless-steel-tank stabilize temperature while extended maceration extracts deep pigment and phenolic structure.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Yeast converts natural grape sugars during active fermentation within the insulated fermentation-tank.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Meticulous barrel racking separates sediment, followed by protein fining and sterile filtering before maturation in a toasted oak-barrel.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Our enologists complete artistic cuvée blending after months of aging, sending the vintage directly to automated bottling.

lessons.name: Winemaking 2
lessons.titleAr: المعدات المعملية والتعميق بالبراميل الخشبية والنضج

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A mechanized destemmer eliminates bitter stalks before a sanitary wine pump transfers whole berries into stainless tanks.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Lab technicians float a calibrated hydrometer to check sugar density and use an electronic pH-meter to monitor chemical balance.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Coopers compare fine-grained French oak with sweet American oak, applying gentle thermal toasting or an intense dark char.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Aging wine in a new barrel infuses bold baking spice, while neutral rest in a seasoned used barrel preserves delicate fruit.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Controlled micro-oxidation softens harsh tannins during sur-lie aging, where weekly bâtonnage stirs fine lees until the corking-machine seals the vintage.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Our portfolio spans full-bodied tannic red wine, crisp unoaked white wine, and refreshing pale Provence rosé.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Secondary bottle fermentation produces effervescent sparkling wine with lively streams of persistent fine bubbles.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Prolonged white skin maceration crafts amber orange wine, whereas biodynamic growers bottle unclarified natural wine without additives.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Late-harvest botrytis creates luscious dessert wine, while freezing winter temperatures yield intensely concentrated ice wine.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: In the Douro tradition, distillers add brandy to halt fermentation, producing luscious Port and classic fortified wine.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Hold your glass toward natural light to inspect radiant color, crystal clarity, and sparkling brilliance.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Notice the deep garnet hue and saturated optical depth across the center, lightening slightly along the outer rim.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Gauge overall opacity against the light and verify whether prolonged bottle aging deposited fine natural sediment.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Swirl the glass to assess high viscosity as dense legs drip rhythmically down the bowl.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Inhale deeply with your nose to detect fresh fruity notes and delicate floral aroma before admiring the complex aged bouquet.

lessons.name: Wine Tasting 2
lessons.titleAr: بنية المذاق والتانينات وملامح النكهة واللمسة الختامية

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Take a focused sip to register the velvety mouthfeel, medium body, and mouthwatering crisp acidity.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Velvety grape tannin constructs a firm architectural structure, gracefully countering faint residual sweetness.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Layers unfurl: damp earthy forest floor, cracked spicy black pepper, and fresh herbaceous bay leaf.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A crushed gravel mineral impression blends seamlessly with rich, toasted oaky notes from barrel aging.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Remarkable structural balance and intriguing complexity sustain an extraordinary finish of unforgettable length.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: A completely dry, crisp white feels delightfully light, acting as a refreshing companion beside an artisan appetizer.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Minerally Muscadet is the premier seafood-pairing, whereas honeyed sweet Sauternes provides an exquisite dessert-pairing.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Delicate cool-climate reds offer smooth texture, while concentrated Syrah delivers a bold, full-bodied experience.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: A rich, velvety vintage Merlot harmonizes effortlessly with aged Gruyère in a classic cheese-pairing.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: For roasted rack of lamb, this powerful reserve creates the definitive structured meat-pairing.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Welcome to this evening's seven-course tasting-menu, paired with a curated vintage wine-flight.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Between heavy courses, refreshing lemon sorbet functions as a palate-cleanser to refresh your sensory perception.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Our kitchen presents the centerpiece main-course: truffled venison loin paired with our flagship estate reserve.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Before dessert, servers present an artisanal cheese-board featuring Comte, Roquefort, and aged goat cheeses.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Each thoughtfully choreographed pairing exemplifies the finest union of culinary innovation and oenological heritage.

lessons.name: The Wine Cellar 1
lessons.titleAr: العمارة تحت الأرضية والتحكم المناخي في القبو

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Thermal insulation and an authentic limestone stone-wall insulate this underground vault behind an airtight wooden cellar-door.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Automated temperature-control and precise humidity-control maintain fifty-five degrees Fahrenheit with continuous fresh ventilation.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Atmospheric dim-lighting illuminates the central oak tasting-table, surrounded by custom redwood wine-rack installations.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: We mandate horizontal-storage across every shelf and dual-temperature wine-fridge to keep the natural cork moist and tight.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Inspect every collector bottle: an unbroken foil capsule guards the closure above an immaculate estate label.

lessons.name: The Wine Cellar 2
lessons.titleAr: سجلات القبو وسكب النبيذ وأدوات السقاة المتخصصة

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: The sommelier records each rare vintage and dedicated bin-number in our archival leather-bound cellar-book.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: A synchronized digital inventory monitors market valuations across our comprehensive private cellar collection.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Select a precision lever corkscrew or two-pronged wine-opener to extract thirty-year-old corks without breakage.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Gently pour the wine into a crystal decanter or through a handheld aerator before filling each burgundy wine-glass.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Attach a drip-free wine-pourer and vacuum wine-stopper, chill a slender champagne-flute in an ice-bucket, and consult the wine-thermometer.

lessons.name: The Wine Cellar 3
lessons.titleAr: أشهر مناطق النبيذ والتربة في العالم

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Our reserves celebrate celebrated French appellations: Left Bank Bordeaux, Grand Cru Burgundy, and vintage Champagne.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Sun-drenched Tuscany produces noble Sangiovese, while barrel-aged Rioja represents Spain's venerable viticultural legacy.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: From the Americas, iconic Cabernet hails from California's renowned Napa Valley, matched by high-elevation Malbec from Mendoza.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Ancient century-old vines thrive in Australia's Barossa Valley, generating Shiraz of intense concentration and spice.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Steep terraced vineyards in Portugal's Douro Valley contrast with the cool, slate-rich river slopes of Germany's Mosel.

lessons.name: The Cocktail Bar 1
lessons.titleAr: عمارة البار وتخطيط المحطة والأكواب الأساسية

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Patrons settle onto an upholstered bar-stool along the polished walnut bar-counter, enjoying the intimate lounge-area.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Behind the counter, an illuminated back-bar showcases our curated bottle-display alongside chilled brass draft-taps.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: I keep well spirits within arm's reach along the speed-rail, positioned right beside a deep stainless ice-well.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: A fresh citrus garnish-tray rests steadily upon a non-slip silicone bar-mat to maintain an immaculate workspace.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Our server presents appropriate glassware: a classic cocktail-glass, tall highball-glass, heavy rocks-glass, shot-glass, and large wine-glass.

lessons.name: The Cocktail Bar 2
lessons.titleEn: Mixology Tools, Bar Prep & Specialized Vessels

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: For service, select an elegant champagne-flute, sturdy beer-mug, slender collins-glass, saucer coupe-glass, or rounded brandy snifter.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Measure spirits accurately using a calibrated jigger and press fresh mint leaves with an ergonomic wooden muddler.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Stir gently with a spiral bar-spoon, or shake vigorously in a weighted cocktail-shaker before pouring through a hawthorne strainer.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Handle artisan ice with delicate ice-tongs, remove bottle caps with a steel bottle-opener, and pull corks using a waiter's corkscrew.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Squeeze fresh lime using a handheld citrus-press and shave aromatic peel strips with a sharp channel zester.

lessons.name: The Cocktail Bar 3
lessons.titleAr: أدوار طاقم الضيافة والخدمة وإدارة السهرات

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Our welcoming host greets arrivals at the foyer while the vigilant bouncer ensures an orderly, secure venue.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: A courteous cocktail-waitress coordinates table service under the watchful direction of our floor manager.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The diligent barback replenishes fresh glassware so the head bartender and innovative mixologist craft drinks without interruption.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Our certified sommelier advises guests on rare vintage bottles and artisanal digestif pairings.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Later on, the resident nightclub dj and creative party promoter create a pulsating yet refined evening atmosphere.

lessons.name: Spirits & Liqueurs 1
lessons.titleAr: المشروبات الروحية الأساسية وأنماط التقطير والمشروبات الكحولية المحلاة

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Our back-bar features neutral grain vodka, juniper gin, aged Caribbean rum, and blue agave tequila.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Whiskey aficionados compare Kentucky corn bourbon, smoky single-malt scotch, and complex blended whiskey.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Distilled fruit spirits include aged French brandy, luxury oak cognac, and earthy, smoke-roasted Mexican mezcal.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: For dessert cordials, we pour zesty orange triple-sec, nutty Italian amaretto, and dark Mexican Kahlúa.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We finish the collection with creamy Irish Baileys and orange-scented French Grand Marnier.

lessons.name: Spirits & Liqueurs 2
lessons.titleAr: مشهيات الكحول والمعدلات والمزج والمشروبات المرة

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Herbal botanicals shine in monastic Chartreuse, bitter red Campari, and vibrant bittersweet Aperol.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: We modify classic cocktails using honeyed spiced Drambuie alongside crystal-clear orange Cointreau.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Chilled effervescent mixers include dry tonic-water, sparkling soda-water, fiery ginger-beer, and artisanal craft cola.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Fresh fruit acids like tart cranberry-juice, freshly pressed orange-juice, and crisp lime-juice brighten each glass.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Balance sweet richness with crystal simple-syrup, crimson pomegranate grenadine, and aromatic dashes of cocktail bitters.

lessons.name: Spirits & Liqueurs 3
lessons.titleAr: زينة الكوكتيل وتزيين حواف الكؤوس واللمسات الجمالية

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Express fragrant oils from a slender lemon-twist or rest a fresh lime-wedge on the edge of the rim.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Flame a fragrant swath of orange-peel over an Old Fashioned, or drop an artisanal brandied cherry into sweet vermouth.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Garnish a dry martini with a briny green olive, or slap a fresh mint-sprig to release botanical perfume.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Stir warmed spiced punches with a fragrant bark cinnamon-stick to infuse warmth into the winter libation.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Finish the visual presentation with a coarse salt-rim, a crystallized sugar-rim, or an eye-catching paper cocktail-umbrella.

lessons.name: Classic Cocktails 1
lessons.titleEn: The Golden Age & Iconic Heritage Recipes
lessons.titleAr: العصر الذهبي ووصفات الكوكتيل الكلاسيكية التاريخية

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Heritage cocktail history revolves around the dry gin martini, bitters-scented old-fashioned, and rye manhattan.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Italian aperitivo culture birthed the bitter negroni, while Caribbean rum powers the tart daiquiri and refreshing mint mojito.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Agave spirit headlines the salted margarita, while rich bourbon and egg white froth define the classic whiskey-sour.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Sophisticated standards include the cognac sidecar, absinthe-rinsed sazerac, and tart cranberry cosmopolitan.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Guests also enjoy creamy piña-colada, potent long-island-iced-tea, copper-mug moscow-mule, and lime-drenched gimlet.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Popular modern orders feature a fizzy tom-collins, grapefruit paloma, and effervescent prosecco aperol-spritz.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Patrons love an invigorating vodka espresso-martini or a spicy Bermuda dark-and-stormy with fiery ginger beer.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Clear spirit drinks are quietly stirred, while citrus libations are vigorously shaken, strained, and double-strained into coupes.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Aromatic herbs are gently muddled, tall drinks are carefully built over ice, and tropical drinks are smoothly blended.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: We present artfully layered cordials, spirits subtly infused with botanicals, and flamed citrus peels for theatrical aroma.

lessons.name: Classic Cocktails 3
lessons.titleAr: مواصفات الطلب ودرجات حرارة التقديم ومستويات المشروبات

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Single malt connoisseurs request their whiskey served unadorned and completely neat at room temperature.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: You can enjoy your favorite spirit poured on-the-rocks over clear ice or chilled and served straight-up in stemware.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: When ordering a martini, clarify whether you prefer a whisper of vermouth in a dry pour or a richer wet balance.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Olive brine creates a savory dirty martini, while mindful guests can request an alcohol-free virgin cocktail.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Choose an economical speed-rail well-drink, or indulge in vintage top-shelf bottles and our barrel-aged house-special.

lessons.name: Bar Culture 1
lessons.titleAr: أماكن الضيافة والأجواء وطقوس طلب المشروبات

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Social options range from a bustling sports-bar and unpretentious dive-bar to a quiet wine-bar and secret vintage speakeasy.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Catch the sunset at a breezy rooftop-bar or escape into tropical island escapism inside a bamboo-lined tiki-bar.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Locals meet at the neighborhood pub, an old timber tavern, or an on-site craft brewpub pouring fresh ales.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Colleagues gather in a relaxed hotel lounge for happy-hour specials, opening a shared tab and purchasing a round-of-drinks.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: When the staff announces last-call, settle your credit tab promptly and reward excellent service with a gracious tip.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Friends raise a heartfelt toast and shout 'cheers', expressing gratitude to their responsible designated-driver.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Guests pay a modest entrance cover-charge, put drinks on their bar-tab, and enjoy energetic acoustic live-music.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Weekly events draw crowds for competitive trivia-night, enthusiastic karaoke singing, and a hilarious weekend comedy-night.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Patrons throw darts at the sisal dart-board, sink stripes and solids at the pool-table, or select songs on the glowing jukebox.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Local performers share stories during open-mic, supporters follow the tournament on a big-screen, and dancers fill the dance-floor.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Healthy social engagement emphasizes personal moderation, reminding everyone to know-your-limit throughout the evening.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Be sure to eat-before arriving, and pace-yourself steadily by taking an occasional hydrating water-break.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Door security performs a thorough id-check to confirm that every entrant meets the strict adult legal-age requirement.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Attentive bartenders have an ethical duty to cut-off intoxicated patrons, substituting tea or tonic water instead.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Never operate a motor vehicle after socializing; book a smartphone ride-share to ensure a safe, peaceful journey home.

lessons.name: L7 Space Center 1
lessons.titleAr: أنظمة الإطلاق والمركبات الفضائية والكواكب الداخلية

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: On the coastal concrete launch-pad, a massive multistage rocket stands upright with an auxiliary solid fuel booster.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Engineers enclose the science payload within protective fairings, mounting the crew escape capsule on top.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Long after the historic space-shuttle fleet retired, modern aerospace firms deploy advanced satellite networks worldwide.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Interplanetary expeditions deploy a solar probe to study the scorching Sun, a stationary surface lander, and an autonomous robotic rover.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Navigators plot trajectories across the inner solar system: cratered Mercury, dense acidic Venus, vibrant Earth, and barren red Mars.

lessons.name: L7 Space Center 2
lessons.titleEn: Outer Giants, Mission Control & Spacewalk Operations
lessons.titleAr: عمالقة الكواكب الخارجية ومركز التحكم والسير في الفضاء

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Flight directors inside mission-control monitor the tense terminal countdown leading up to thunderous liftoff.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: After achieving stable low Earth orbit, deep-space probes swing past our Moon to encounter gas giants Jupiter and majestic Saturn.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Long-range sensors image distant icy Uranus, stormy Neptune, a metallic asteroid, and the dusty tail of an incoming comet.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Dressed in a pressurized spacesuit and gold-coated helmet, an intrepid astronaut steps through the airlock hatch.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Conducting a complex six-hour spacewalk, the flight engineer repairs external solar arrays high above the blue planet.

lessons.name: L7 Space Center 3
lessons.titleAr: الفيزياء الفلكية والظواهر الكونية وإعادة الدخول للغلاف الجوي

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Automated guidance completes laser docking at the station while extending a deployable power solar-panel array.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: An orbital space telescope captures light from a newborn star, an iridescent glowing nebula, and a distant spiral galaxy.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Astrophysicists study the gravitational singularity of a black-hole, cataclysmic supernova explosions, and interstellar cosmic-dust.

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Stargazers identify each zodiac constellation, marvel at a blazing meteor streak, photograph polar aurora lights, and watch a solar eclipse.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Upon mission completion, the return capsule endures searing atmospheric re-entry before a triumphant ocean splashdown.

lessons.name: L7 Space Center 4
lessons.titleAr: إلكترونيات الطيران وأنظمة الدفع والعزل الحراري

script.speaker: Tariq
script.text: Telemetry relays via a high-gain dish antenna synchronized with ground tracking radar stations around the globe.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: The onboard flight computer executes real-time orbital corrections by firing each hydrazine attitude control thruster.

script.speaker: Hana
script.text: Insulated cryogenic valves channel liquid hydrogen propellant from the primary titanium fuel-tank directly into the engines.

script.speaker: Layla
script.text: Specialists manipulate an exterior articulated robotic-arm to transfer microgravity experiment pallets into the orbital laboratory.

script.speaker: Adam
script.text: Ablative ceramic tiles across the base heat-shield absorb incandescent plasma heat until a massive orange recovery parachute unfurls.
